government_service:accounts-clerk-cum-ty.label: Pay level
government_service:accounts-clerk-cum-ty.text: In CEN 07/2025 context, Accounts Clerk cum Typist was notified at 7th CPC Pay Level 2 with initial basic pay of ₹19,900.

government_service:accounts-clerk-cum-ty.label: Career progression context
government_service:accounts-clerk-cum-ty.text: Entry: Accounts Clerk cum Typist, Pay Level 2.

government_service:accounts-clerk-cum-ty.label: Pay and benefits context
government_service:accounts-clerk-cum-ty.text: For the 2025 NTPC undergraduate notification cycle, Accounts Clerk cum Typist was listed at 7th CPC Pay Level 2 with ₹19,900 initial basic pay.

government_service:accounts-clerk-cum-ty.label: Pay and benefits context
government_service:accounts-clerk-cum-ty.text: Dated recruitment context: CEN 07/2025 listed Level 2 and ₹19,900 initial basic pay.

government_service:administrative-assist.label: Pay context
government_service:administrative-assist.text: A February 2024 Gazette recruitment rule names Administrative Assistant ‘B’ as a Level 4 post in the Central Pay Matrix (₹25,500–81,100 basic-pay range).

government_service:administrative-assist.label: Compensation context
government_service:administrative-assist.text: For current pay-scale context, a February 2024 official Gazette rule lists Administrative Assistant ‘B’ at Pay Matrix Level 4, ₹25,500–81,100.

government_service:administrative-assist.label: Compensation context
government_service:administrative-assist.text: Reference basic-pay range: Level 4, ₹25,500–81,100, as identified in a February 2024 Gazette rule.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Primary entry route: UPSC CAPF (ACs) examination
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: For example, the 2026 application deadline was March 12, 2026, and the examination fee was ₹200 for candidates not exempted; women and SC/ST candidates were exempt under that notice.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Position and cadre context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: Assistant Commandant is a Group A, Gazetted, Non-Ministerial rank in CISF; a CISF Assistant Commandant/Fire vacancy notice identifies the corresponding revised pay level as Level 10 under the 7th CPC.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: A CISF notice for Assistant Commandant/Fire describes the post as revised Pay Level 10, with the 7th CPC matrix range of ₹56,100–₹1,77,500.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: The cited notice concerned AC/Fire on deputation, but it is official evidence for the Group A Assistant Commandant Level 10 pay context.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: Do not infer a fixed monthly in-hand salary solely from the Level 10 range.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: Official cited pay context: revised Pay Level 10, ₹56,100–₹1,77,500.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Pay context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: Assistant Commandant is referenced by the Ministry of Home Affairs as Pay Matrix Level 10.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Pay context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: The Seventh Central Pay Commission’s Level 10 entry-pay example is ₹56,100 basic pay; actual monthly earnings depend on prevailing allowances, posting, deductions, and pay rules.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Compensation: pay-matrix context, not a fixed take-home figure
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: The Ministry of Home Affairs has identified Assistant Commandant as Level 10 in the central pay matrix in a CAPF-related vacancy document.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Compensation: pay-matrix context, not a fixed take-home figure
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: The Seventh Central Pay Commission’s published entry-pay example for direct recruitment at Level 10 is ₹56,100 basic pay.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Compensation: pay-matrix context, not a fixed take-home figure
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: Base-pay reference: Level 10, with the Seventh CPC’s stated direct-entry example of ₹56,100 basic pay.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Pay context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: The 2018 ITBP General Duty Group A recruitment rules list Assistant Commandant at Pay Matrix Level 10, ₹56,100–₹1,77,500.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Career progression
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: Under the published 2018 General Duty Group A recruitment rules, promotion from Assistant Commandant to Deputy Commandant requires five years of regular service in Level 10, including two years’ experience as Company Commander of a service company in a service battalion, plus successful completion of the prescribed pre-promotional training course; the rules specify an exception to that company-commander condition for officers in the central sports team.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Career progression
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: The same rules list Deputy Commandant at Level 11, Second-in-Command at Level 12 and Commandant at Level 13.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Career progression
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: Entry rank: Assistant Commandant (General Duty), Level 10.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Career progression
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: Next published rank: Deputy Commandant (General Duty), Level 11.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Career progression
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: Subsequent published ranks include Second-in-Command (Level 12) and Commandant (Level 13).

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: The ITBP General Duty Group A recruitment rules published in 2018 place Assistant Commandant at Level 10 of the Central Government pay matrix: ₹56,100–₹1,77,500.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: ITBP recruitment material for another Group A Assistant Commandant cadre describes Level 10 pay plus admissible ITBP/MHA allowances and coverage under the government’s contributory pension arrangement; applicants should confirm the terms in the notification and appointment conditions applicable to their own recruitment cycle and cadre.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: Published basic-pay context: Level 10, ₹56,100–₹1,77,500.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Pay context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: The Ministry of Home Affairs’ 2026 CAPF (AC) examination rules place Assistant Commandant in Level 10, junior scale, of the pay matrix: ₹56,100–₹177,500 basic-pay range.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Officer hierarchy and early career development
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: For officers recruited through CAPF (AC), the 2026 Ministry of Home Affairs rules set Assistant Commandant at Level 10 and list the succeeding CAPF scales through Inspector General.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Officer hierarchy and early career development
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: Entry rank: Assistant Commandant (Level 10 in the 2026 CAPF rules).

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Officer hierarchy and early career development
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: Next listed CAPF officer rank: Deputy Commandant (Level 11 in the 2026 rules).

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: As notified in the Ministry of Home Affairs’ 2026 CAPF (AC) examination rules, Assistant Commandant is in Pay Matrix Level 10 (junior scale), ₹56,100–₹177,500.

government_service:assistant-commandant-.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-commandant-.text: Published 2026 basic-pay matrix: Level 10, ₹56,100–₹177,500.

government_service:assistant-commissione.label: Pay context
government_service:assistant-commissione.text: As dated examples rather than a national salary promise: Telangana’s 2024 Group-I notice showed ₹54,220–₹1,33,630 for the post, while a Maharashtra Labour Department promotion order described Assistant Commissioner of Labour, Group A at Pay Matrix Level S-18 (₹49,100–₹1,55,800).

government_service:assistant-commissione.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-commissione.text: For dated official context only, Telangana’s 2024 Group-I notification listed Assistant Commissioner of Labour at ₹54,220–₹1,33,630, while a Maharashtra Labour Department order described the Group A post at Pay Matrix Level S-18, ₹49,100–₹1,55,800.

government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.label: Drug Inspector feeder route
government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.text: In that Medical Device Vertical cadre, Drugs Inspectors in Pay Level 8 may be promoted to ADC(I) after eight years of regular service and the prescribed mandatory training.

government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.label: Illustrative central pay context
government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.text: The 2024 Medical Device Vertical rules place ADC(I) at Pay Level 11, ₹67,700–₹2,08,700 in the pay matrix.

government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.label: Entry routes and eligibility context
government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.text: The same rules establish an internal route from Drugs Inspector (Medical Devices): eight years of regular service in Level 8 plus prescribed mandatory training.

government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.label: Progression from Drug Inspector
government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.text: The next higher central position is Deputy Drugs Controller (India): the 2025 recruitment rules for that post specify promotion from ADC(I) in Level 11 after five years' regular service and prescribed training.

government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.label: Progression from Drug Inspector
government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.text: Assistant Drugs Controller (India) → Deputy Drugs Controller (India): the 2025 CDSCO rule specifies five years' regular service in Level 11 and prescribed training.

government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.text: For the central Medical Device Vertical, the 2024 recruitment rules specify Pay Level 11, ₹67,700–₹2,08,700, for ADC(I).

government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-drugs-contr.text: Use Pay Level 11 only as a dated central Medical Device Vertical reference.

government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.label: Typical status and pay level
government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.text: For example, the Central Water Commission’s Farakka Barrage Project describes Assistant Engineer (Civil) as a General Central Service Group ‘B’, Gazetted, Non-Ministerial post in Pay Matrix Level 7 (basic-pay range ₹44,900–₹1,42,400 under the 7th CPC matrix).

government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.label: Career context
government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.text: A 2025 Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology recruitment-rule notification lists nine years’ regular Level-7 Assistant Engineer service as one route for consideration to Executive Engineer (Civil), alongside other conditions.

government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.label: Entry routes from Junior Engineer and related routes
government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.text: The Central Water Commission’s Farakka Barrage Project deputation description instead specified a civil-engineering degree and five years of regular Level-6 service for the stated route.

government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.label: Progression after Assistant Engineer
government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.text: In a 2025 MeitY notification, Executive Engineer (Civil) at Level 11 could be filled by promotion/deputation from a Level-7 Assistant Engineer (Civil) with nine years’ regular service, subject to the specified degree and construction/maintenance experience requirements.

government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.text: As of the cited recruitment and vacancy documents, several central-government Assistant Engineer (Civil) posts are placed at 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 7, whose basic-pay range is ₹44,900–₹1,42,400.

government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.text: The Central Water Commission example identifies a Group B Gazetted, Non-Ministerial post, and a MeitY recruitment-rule notification likewise lists Assistant Engineer (Civil) as Group B Gazetted, Non-Ministerial at Level 7.

government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-engineer-ce.text: Treat ₹44,900–₹1,42,400 as cited Level-7 basic-pay context, not an in-hand-pay promise.

government_service:assistant-engineer-st.label: Pay context
government_service:assistant-engineer-st.text: As a dated example, Goa’s 2026 advertisement for an Assistant Engineer in its Environment and Climate Change Department listed Pay Matrix Level 7; candidates must use the applicable state notification for current pay, allowances, and service conditions.

government_service:assistant-engineer-st.label: Entry routes and eligibility
government_service:assistant-engineer-st.text: Goa’s 2026 deputation advertisement, for example, sought eligible officials in an equivalent or feeder pay level with specified service and a relevant Civil Engineering degree.

government_service:assistant-engineer-st.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-engineer-st.text: For a time-specific reference, Goa’s advertisement with an application window from 8 May 2026 to 22 June 2026 listed an Assistant Engineer post at Pay Matrix Level 7.

government_service:assistant-executive-e.label: Pay-level context
government_service:assistant-executive-e.text: The Engineering Services Examination Rules notified on September 26, 2025 place both AEE (Civil) and AEE (E&M) in BRES at Pay Matrix Level 10.

government_service:assistant-executive-e.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-executive-e.text: As of the Engineering Services Examination Rules notified on September 26, 2025, the entry AEE post in both the Civil and E&M BRES cadres is at Pay Matrix Level 10.

government_service:assistant-executive-e.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-executive-e.text: Entry pay context: Pay Matrix Level 10 under the September 26, 2025 ESE rules.

government_service:assistant-executive-e.label: Pay context
government_service:assistant-executive-e.text: A Ministry of Jal Shakti appointment offer dated September 19, 2024 states that JTS Assistant Director/Assistant Executive Engineer appointees would have pay fixed at Pay Matrix Level 10, ₹56,100–₹1,77,500 per month, plus admissible Central Government allowances.

government_service:assistant-executive-e.label: Level 10 basic-pay framework; allowances and net pay vary
government_service:assistant-executive-e.text: For dated, official context, the Ministry of Jal Shakti’s September 19, 2024 offer to ESE-2023 CWES appointees fixed entry JTS pay at Level 10 of the Central Government pay matrix: ₹56,100–₹1,77,500 per month, with allowances admissible to Central Government officers of that grade.

government_service:assistant-executive-e.label: Level 10 basic-pay framework; allowances and net pay vary
government_service:assistant-executive-e.text: Official dated entry-pay reference: Level 10, ₹56,100–₹1,77,500 basic-pay matrix range in the September 19, 2024 CWES offer.

government_service:assistant-executive-e.label: Entry pay context
government_service:assistant-executive-e.text: The ESE 2026 Rules’ service particulars list Assistant Executive Engineer in the IDSE cadre at 7th CPC Pay Level 10, with basic-pay range ₹56,100–₹1,77,500.

government_service:assistant-executive-e.label: Indicative IDSE cadre progression
government_service:assistant-executive-e.text: The ESE 2026 Rules list the following IDSE pay-grade sequence: Assistant Executive Engineer (Level 10), Executive Engineer (Level 11), Executive Engineer (NFSG, Level 12), Superintending Engineer (Level 13), Chief Engineer (Level 14), and Additional Director General and Director General (both Level 15 in the listed particulars).

government_service:assistant-executive-e.label: Indicative IDSE cadre progression
government_service:assistant-executive-e.text: Assistant Executive Engineer — Level 10 entry grade.

government_service:assistant-executive-e.label: Indicative IDSE cadre progression
government_service:assistant-executive-e.text: Additional Director General and Director General — Level 15 in the ESE 2026 service particulars.

government_service:assistant-executive-e.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-executive-e.text: For the ESE 2026 service particulars published in the Gazette, the IDSE Assistant Executive Engineer basic-pay range is ₹56,100–₹1,77,500 at 7th CPC Level 10.

government_service:assistant-executive-e.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-executive-e.text: Notified ESE 2026 entry basic-pay context: Level 10, ₹56,100–₹1,77,500.

government_service:assistant-loco-pilot-.label: Pay context
government_service:assistant-loco-pilot-.text: For CEN 01/2026, ALP was listed at 7th CPC Pay Level 2 with initial basic pay of ₹19,900.

government_service:assistant-loco-pilot-.label: Progression from ALP
government_service:assistant-loco-pilot-.text: That document notes that promotion to the relevant Level-6 posts involves seniority-cum-suitability with the prescribed benchmark, footplate experience, aptitude testing where prescribed, and pre-promotional training/written testing.

government_service:assistant-loco-pilot-.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-loco-pilot-.text: In the CEN 01/2026 recruitment notice, Assistant Loco Pilot was placed in 7th CPC Pay Level 2 with initial pay of ₹19,900.

government_service:assistant-loco-pilot-.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-loco-pilot-.text: Dated reference point: ₹19,900 initial basic pay at Pay Level 2 in CEN 01/2026.

government_service:assistant-loco-pilot-.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-loco-pilot-.text: During prescribed initial training, the 2026 notice states that only a stipend is paid.

government_service:assistant-section-off.label: Pay context
government_service:assistant-section-off.text: The CSS ASO grade is Pay Level 7.

government_service:assistant-section-off.label: Pay context
government_service:assistant-section-off.text: SSC’s CGL notice lists the Level 7 pay range as ₹44,900–₹1,42,400; actual monthly take-home pay varies with the applicable pay-matrix stage, allowances, deductions, posting, and rules in force.

government_service:assistant-section-off.label: How to enter the CSS ASO grade
government_service:assistant-section-off.text: SSC’s CGL notice lists ASO, Central Secretariat Service under Pay Level 7 and a 20–30 age band for that notice; it also specifies a bachelor’s degree for posts in the general “all other posts” category.

government_service:assistant-section-off.label: Progression within CSS
government_service:assistant-section-off.text: Entry: Assistant Section Officer — Group B, non-gazetted, Level 7.

government_service:assistant-section-off.label: Progression within CSS
government_service:assistant-section-off.text: Next grade: Section Officer — reported by DoPT as Group B gazetted, Level 8, with a reported non-functional Level 10 after four years of approved service for eligible Section Officers under the applicable arrangements.

government_service:assistant-section-off.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-section-off.text: As reflected in SSC notices available in 2026, the CSS ASO post is in Pay Level 7, whose stated pay-matrix range is ₹44,900 to ₹1,42,400.

government_service:assistant-section-off.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-section-off.text: For comparison within the reported CSS hierarchy, DoPT lists ASO at Level 7 and Section Officer at Level 8, with a cited non-functional Level 10 arrangement after four years of approved service for Section Officers.

government_service:assistant-section-off.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-section-off.text: Dated official context: Level 7 basic-pay range ₹44,900–₹1,42,400 in SSC notices available in 2026.

government_service:assistant-sub-inspect.label: Usual feeder rank in the ITBP GD example
government_service:assistant-sub-inspect.text: ITBP’s 2022 General Duty recruitment rules provide for promotion to ASI (GD) from Head Constable (GD) with five years’ regular service in Pay Level 4 and successful completion of the prescribed pre-promotional training course; the rule provides deputation only if promotion fails.

government_service:assistant-sub-inspect.label: Pay-matrix context
government_service:assistant-sub-inspect.text: The ITBP 2022 rules place ASI (GD) at Pay Level 5, with the then-stated matrix range of ₹29,200–₹92,300.

government_service:assistant-sub-inspect.label: How the Head Constable-to-ASI route works
government_service:assistant-sub-inspect.text: ITBP GD benchmark: five years’ regular service as Head Constable (GD) in Pay Level 4.

government_service:assistant-sub-inspect.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-sub-inspect.text: For a dated, official benchmark, ITBP’s General Duty recruitment rules notified in 2022 specify Pay Level 5 (₹29,200–₹92,300) for ASI (GD), compared with Pay Level 4 for Head Constable (GD).

government_service:assistant-sub-inspect.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-sub-inspect.text: Use ₹29,200–₹92,300 only as the basic matrix range stated in the 2022 ITBP ASI (GD) rule.

government_service:assistant-sub-inspect.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-sub-inspect.text: The rule’s stated Head Constable (GD) feeder level is Pay Level 4, ₹25,500–₹81,100.

government_service:assistant-town-planne.label: Pay context
government_service:assistant-town-planne.text: A Manipur Town Planning Department disclosure updated in April 2025 listed Assistant Town Planner at Pay Level 9 with pay band ₹43,300, while a Kerala departmental-quota notice dated December 31, 2024 listed ₹55,200–₹1,15,300.

government_service:assistant-town-planne.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-town-planne.text: As dated reference points, Manipur’s Town Planning Department disclosure, updated April 2025, lists Assistant Town Planner at Pay Level 9 and ₹43,300;

government_service:assistant-town-planne.label: Compensation context
government_service:assistant-town-planne.text: Kerala PSC’s December 31, 2024 departmental-quota notification lists a scale of ₹55,200–₹1,15,300.

government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.label: Recruiting examination and post classification
government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.text: The Staff Selection Commission’s CGL notice lists “Auditor — Offices under C&AG” as a Group C post at Pay Level 5, with an age band of 18–27 years in that notice.

government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.label: Pay context
government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.text: The SSC notice cited above shows Pay Level 5 as ₹29,200–₹92,300 in the pay matrix.

government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.label: Primary entry route: SSC CGL
government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.text: The SSC notice lists Auditor in Offices under C&AG as a Group C, Pay Level 5 post.

government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.label: Progression and the SAS pathway
government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.text: Entry role: Auditor, Pay Level 5, in an Audit Office.

government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.label: Progression and the SAS pathway
government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.text: Published intermediate category: Senior Auditor, Pay Level 6, appears in the SAS eligibility framework.

government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.label: Compensation context
government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.text: As a dated reference point, the SSC CGL notice available for the 2026 eligibility cycle lists Auditor in Offices under C&AG at Pay Level 5, with the pay-matrix range ₹29,200–₹92,300.

government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.label: Compensation context
government_service:auditor-in-comptrolle.text: Published pay context in that notice: Pay Level 5, ₹29,200–₹92,300.

government_service:ayurvedic-medical-off.label: Compensation context: highly appointment-specific
government_service:ayurvedic-medical-off.text: As dated examples, HPPSC advertised an Ayurvedic Medical Officer (Job Trainee) role in February 2026 at ₹29,500 per month, while the Goa State AYUSH Society advertised a one-year National AYUSH Mission Medical Officer (Ayurveda) contract in January 2026 at ₹40,000 per month, described as ₹25,000 fixed plus ₹15,000 performance-linked incentive.

government_service:block-development-off.label: Compensation context
government_service:block-development-off.text: In 2026, Goa PSC listed BDO at revised pay-matrix Level 7, while an Assam appointment notification listed Pay Band 4, ₹30,000–₹1,10,000 with ₹12,700 grade pay, plus admissible allowances.

government_service:block-development-off.label: Compensation context
government_service:block-development-off.text: As dated examples rather than universal benchmarks: Goa PSC’s advertisement uploaded on May 8, 2026 placed BDO at revised pay-matrix Level 7.

government_service:block-development-off.label: Compensation context
government_service:block-development-off.text: Assam’s March 4, 2026 appointment notification for BDOs selected through its Combined Competitive Examination stated a Pay Band 4 scale of ₹30,000–₹1,10,000 with ₹12,700 grade pay per month, plus allowances admissible under government rules.

government_service:chief-commercial-cum-.label: Pay level
government_service:chief-commercial-cum-.text: CEN 05/2024 listed Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor at Level 6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, with initial pay of ₹35,400.

government_service:chief-commercial-cum-.label: Entry through RRB NTPC (graduate)
government_service:chief-commercial-cum-.text: CEN 05/2024 listed Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor as a Level-6 graduate post and required a university degree or equivalent.

government_service:chief-commercial-cum-.label: Career development context
government_service:chief-commercial-cum-.text: Published Railway material also shows Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor as a Level-6 selection post and identifies higher commercial levels in departmental restructuring discussions; however, an individual's promotion path depends on applicable Railway Board rules, seniority, eligibility, vacancies, selection processes, and the cadre structure of the particular railway or division.

government_service:chief-commercial-cum-.label: Pay and compensation context
government_service:chief-commercial-cum-.text: For dated context, CEN 05/2024 placed Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor in Pay Level 6 under the 7th CPC and stated initial pay of ₹35,400.

government_service:chief-commercial-cum-.label: Pay and compensation context
government_service:chief-commercial-cum-.text: CEN 05/2024 context: 7th CPC Pay Level 6; initial basic pay ₹35,400.

government_service:civil-judge-cum-judic.label: Responsibilities: civil-court judging combined with criminal-magisterial powers
government_service:civil-judge-cum-judic.text: In the criminal-magisterial capacity, a first-class Magistrate has the sentencing authority specified by BNSS section 23: imprisonment up to three years, a fine up to ₹50,000, both, or community service, subject to the statute and the facts of the case.

government_service:civil-judge-junior-di.label: Compensation context
government_service:civil-judge-junior-di.text: As a dated illustration only—not a nationwide salary benchmark—the Punjab and Haryana High Court’s Haryana gradation list published in 2026 displays ₹77,840 alongside several serving Civil Judge (Junior Division)/JMIC entries.

government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.label: Recruitment category
government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.text: Commercial Cum Ticket Clerk (CCTC) is an RRB Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC) undergraduate post, listed at Pay Level 3 in the 7th Central Pay Commission pay matrix.

government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.label: Selection route
government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.text: For CCTC, CEN 06/2024 specified two computer-based tests, followed by document verification and a Railway medical examination; unlike clerical-typist posts, it did not specify a typing-skill test for CCTC.

government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.label: Medical standard
government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.text: The CCTC post was notified with medical standard B2 in CEN 06/2024.

government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.label: Entry basic pay context
government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.text: The CEN 06/2024 notification stated an initial basic pay of ₹21,700 for CCTC at Pay Level 3.

government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.label: How to enter through RRB NTPC
government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.text: The CEN 06/2024 pattern for CCTC was first-stage CBT, second-stage CBT, document verification, and medical examination.

government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.label: How to enter through RRB NTPC
government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.text: Existing Railway staff may also enter the grade through departmental selection where a Railway administration notifies such a quota; for example, South Central Railway published a CCTC Level-3 selection under an LDCE quota.

government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.label: Skills developed and used
government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.text: A typing test was not prescribed for CCTC in CEN 06/2024, but computer use and accurate data entry remain relevant operational skills.

government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.label: Progression and professional development
government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.text: A Senior Commercial Cum Ticket Clerk has also been notified as a distinct higher-level NTPC graduate post at Pay Level 5 in Railway recruitment material.

government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.label: Compensation context
government_service:commercial-cum-ticket.text: CEN 06/2024 placed CCTC at Level 3 of the 7th CPC pay matrix with an initial basic pay of ₹21,700.

government_service:community-health-offi.label: Compensation context
government_service:community-health-offi.text: As dated illustrations only: a UP NHM CHO-CCHN notice stated a training stipend of ₹10,000 per month and, on posting, up to ₹35,500 per month consisting of ₹20,500 salary plus up to ₹15,000 performance-based incentive.

government_service:community-health-offi.label: Compensation context
government_service:community-health-offi.text: A Kozhikode NHM notice dated December 30, 2025 listed a Mid Level Service Provider rate of ₹20,500 per month during training and ₹20,500 plus ₹1,000 fixed travelling allowance after successful training.

government_service:constable-general-dut.label: Pay context
government_service:constable-general-dut.text: The SSC GD 2026 notice specified Pay Level 3, ₹21,700–₹69,100, for the advertised posts.

government_service:constable-general-dut.label: Compensation context
government_service:constable-general-dut.text: As dated recruitment context, SSC’s Constable (GD) 2026 notice listed Pay Level 3 at ₹21,700–₹69,100 for all posts covered by that notice.

government_service:data-entry-operator-d.label: C&AG cadre levels
government_service:data-entry-operator-d.text: C&AG office disclosures list DEO Grade ‘A’ as Group C, non-gazetted, Pay Level 4, and DEO Grade ‘B’ as Group C, non-gazetted, Pay Level 5.

government_service:data-entry-operator-d.label: Compensation context: central pay levels rather than a single fixed take-home salary
government_service:data-entry-operator-d.text: As dated context, SSC’s CHSL 2025 notice listed DEO posts at Pay Level 4 (₹25,500–₹81,100) and Pay Level 5 (₹29,200–₹92,300), while DEO Grade ‘A’ was listed at Pay Level 4 (₹25,500–₹81,100).

government_service:data-entry-operator-d.label: Compensation context: central pay levels rather than a single fixed take-home salary
government_service:data-entry-operator-d.text: C&AG office RTI disclosures likewise identify DEO Grade A with Level 4 and Grade B with Level 5.

government_service:data-entry-operator-d.label: Compensation context: central pay levels rather than a single fixed take-home salary
government_service:data-entry-operator-d.text: DEO Grade A: commonly shown in official SSC/C&AG material at Pay Level 4.

government_service:data-entry-operator-d.label: Compensation context: central pay levels rather than a single fixed take-home salary
government_service:data-entry-operator-d.text: DEO Grade B in the C&AG EDP cadre: commonly shown at Pay Level 5.

government_service:data-entry-operator-g.label: Central SSC EDP-cadre status
government_service:data-entry-operator-g.text: Under the Electronic Data Processing Cadre (Group C post) Recruitment Rules, 2024 for the Staff Selection Commission, DEO Grade B is a General Central Service, Group C, non-gazetted and non-ministerial post at Pay Matrix Level 5 (basic-pay range ₹29,200–₹92,300).

government_service:data-entry-operator-g.label: One documented internal route
government_service:data-entry-operator-g.text: In the SSC Electronic Data Processing cadre, DEO Grade B is filled by promotion from DEO Grade A after five years of regular Level-4 service and four weeks of relevant training; if promotion cannot fill the post, the rules provide for deputation.

government_service:data-entry-operator-g.label: Recent recruitment context
government_service:data-entry-operator-g.text: SSC’s 2025 Selection Post Phase XIII notice included a DEO Grade B vacancy at the Central Leprosy Teaching and Research Institute, Directorate General of Health Services, with an age band of 18–30, graduation-and-above qualification category, and Pay Level 6—illustrating that department-specific advertised posts can differ from the SSC EDP-cadre rules.

government_service:data-entry-operator-g.label: Entry routes and eligibility: identify the employing cadre first
government_service:data-entry-operator-g.text: The promotion feeder is DEO Grade A at Level 4 with five years of regular service and successful completion of four weeks’ relevant training.

government_service:data-entry-operator-g.label: Entry routes and eligibility: identify the employing cadre first
government_service:data-entry-operator-g.text: For deputation in that SSC cadre, the rules require Central Government officers holding an analogous post, or officers with five years of regular Level-4 service, plus 12th-standard Science with Mathematics and a computer speed test of at least 15,000 key depressions per hour.

government_service:data-entry-operator-g.label: Entry routes and eligibility: identify the employing cadre first
government_service:data-entry-operator-g.text: Separately, SSC’s 2025 Selection Post notice listed a Grade-B vacancy at the Central Leprosy Teaching and Research Institute as a graduation-and-above, 18–30, Level-6 position.

government_service:data-entry-operator-g.label: Career progression
government_service:data-entry-operator-g.text: A documented progression route exists within the SSC Electronic Data Processing cadre: DEO Grade A at Level 4 can be considered for promotion to DEO Grade B after five years of regular service and successful completion of four weeks of relevant training.

government_service:data-entry-operator-g.label: Compensation context
government_service:data-entry-operator-g.text: In the SSC Electronic Data Processing Cadre Recruitment Rules, 2024, DEO Grade B is Pay Matrix Level 5, with the stated basic-pay range of ₹29,200–₹92,300.

government_service:data-entry-operator-g.label: Compensation context
government_service:data-entry-operator-g.text: LBSNAA’s June 2024 deputation circular likewise identified its Grade-B post as Level 5 and stated that dearness allowance, house-rent allowance and other allowances would be admissible under Central Government orders from time to time.

government_service:data-entry-operator-g.label: Compensation context
government_service:data-entry-operator-g.text: However, SSC’s 2025 Selection Post Phase XIII notice listed the Central Leprosy Teaching and Research Institute Grade-B vacancy at Level 6.

government_service:data-entry-operator-g.label: Compensation context
government_service:data-entry-operator-g.text: Thus, ₹29,200–₹92,300 is useful 2024 Level-5 basic-pay context for the SSC EDP cadre; it is not a reliable universal salary figure for every Grade-B vacancy.

government_service:data-entry-operator-g.label: Compensation context
government_service:data-entry-operator-g.text: Treat compensation figures as dated context: the cited Level-5 range is from 2024 rules, while the cited Level-6 example is from an SSC 2025 vacancy notice.

government_service:dental-hygienist-in-i.label: 2024 pay and medical standard
government_service:dental-hygienist-in-i.text: For the 2024 notification only, the post was Pay Level 6 under the 7th CPC, with initial pay of ₹35,400 and medical standard C2.

government_service:dental-hygienist-in-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:dental-hygienist-in-i.text: In CEN 04/2024, Dental Hygienist was listed at 7th CPC Pay Level 6 with initial pay of ₹35,400.

government_service:dental-hygienist-in-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:dental-hygienist-in-i.text: Verify the detailed CEN and appointment terms before making financial decisions. 2024 notice context: Pay Level 6, initial pay ₹35,400.

government_service:deputy-superintendent.label: Compensation context
government_service:deputy-superintendent.text: As dated context only, TNPSC's 21 July 2022 Group I notification placed DySP (Category I) in the Tamil Nadu Police Service and showed a revised Level 22 scale of ₹56,100–₹205,700 for the listed Group I posts.

government_service:dialysis-technician-i.label: Entry pay context
government_service:dialysis-technician-i.text: In CEN 03/2025, the post was in 7th CPC Pay Level 6 with initial basic pay of ₹35,400.

government_service:dialysis-technician-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:dialysis-technician-i.text: For the CEN 03/2025 recruitment cycle, Dialysis Technician was listed at 7th CPC Pay Level 6 with ₹35,400 as initial basic pay.

government_service:dialysis-technician-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:dialysis-technician-i.text: Dated recruitment reference: Pay Level 6; initial basic pay ₹35,400 in CEN 03/2025.

government_service:drug-inspector.label: Current central-service reference
government_service:drug-inspector.text: CDSCO's recruitment-and-rules index lists “DI RRs 11.11.2025” / “Recruitment Rules for Drugs Inspector 2025,” as well as separate rules for Assistant Drugs Controller (India).

government_service:ecg-technician-in-ind.label: Recruitment parameters in CEN 03/2025
government_service:ecg-technician-in-ind.text: The August 2025 notice listed ECG Technician at 7th CPC Pay Level 4, initial basic pay of ₹25,500, C1 medical standard, and age 18–33 as on January 1, 2026.

government_service:ecg-technician-in-ind.label: Pay context
government_service:ecg-technician-in-ind.text: For dated context only, CEN 03/2025 listed ECG Technician at 7th CPC Pay Level 4 with an initial basic pay of ₹25,500.

government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.label: Pay context
government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.text: Under the pay scales stated in the 2024 ESE Rules, Junior Time Scale (Assistant Manager/Assistant Director of Naval Armaments) is Pay Matrix Level 10, ₹56,100–₹177,500 basic pay.

government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.label: Career progression
government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.text: The 2024 ESE Rules set out an INAS grade ladder from Junior Time Scale Assistant Manager/Assistant Director of Naval Armaments (Level 10) to Manager/Deputy Director (Level 11), Deputy General Manager/Joint Director (Level 12), General Manager/Additional General Manager/Principal Director/Director (Level 13), Chief General Manager/Deputy Director General (Level 14), and Director General of Naval Armament (Level 15).

government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.label: Career progression
government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.text: Level 10: Assistant Manager / Assistant Director of Naval Armaments.

government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.label: Career progression
government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.text: Level 11: Manager / Deputy Director of Naval Armaments.

government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.label: Career progression
government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.text: Level 12–13: Deputy General Manager or Joint Director; then General Manager, Additional General Manager, Principal Director or Director roles.

government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.label: Career progression
government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.text: Level 14–15: Chief General Manager or Deputy Director General; potentially Director General of Naval Armament.

government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.text: The published 2024 ESE Rules classify the entry Junior Time Scale INAS post as Group A Gazetted and state a Level 10 basic-pay range of ₹56,100–₹177,500.

government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.text: The same document lists Level 11 through Level 15 ranges for higher INAS grades, culminating in the Director General of Naval Armament at Level 15, ₹182,200–₹224,100 basic pay.

government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.text: These figures are the 7th CPC Pay Matrix values reproduced in the 2024 Rules, not a promise of current gross or take-home salary.

government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.text: Entry JTS: Level 10, ₹56,100–₹177,500 basic pay in the 2024 Rules.

government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.text: Senior Time Scale: Level 11, ₹67,700–₹208,700 basic pay in the 2024 Rules.

government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:engineer-officer-in-i.text: Director General of Naval Armament: Level 15.

government_service:fisheries-development.label: Compensation context
government_service:fisheries-development.text: As dated historical context only, a Jammu & Kashmir official notice published on June 17, 2021 listed Fisheries Development Officer at Level 8, ₹47,600–₹151,100.

government_service:fisheries-extension-o.label: Compensation context
government_service:fisheries-extension-o.text: Kerala PSC’s Category No. 045/2026 notification lists a scale of ₹50,200–₹1,05,300 for Fisheries Extension Officer.

government_service:fisheries-extension-o.label: Compensation context
government_service:fisheries-extension-o.text: By comparison, West Bengal PSC’s 2024 recruitment advertisement listed Level 10 of its pay matrix, ₹32,100–₹82,900, for a combined group that included Fishery Extension Officer.

government_service:goods-train-manager-i.label: Recruiting cadre and level
government_service:goods-train-manager-i.text: Goods Train Manager is a Level-5 post under the 7th Central Pay Commission in the Indian Railways operating/traffic establishment.

government_service:goods-train-manager-i.label: Dated pay context
government_service:goods-train-manager-i.text: CEN 05/2024 notified an initial basic pay of ₹29,200 for Goods Train Manager at Level 5.

government_service:goods-train-manager-i.label: Entry routes and eligibility
government_service:goods-train-manager-i.text: For example, CEN 05/2024 listed Goods Train Manager as a graduate post, with a university degree or equivalent, Level 5, and A-2 medical standard.

government_service:goods-train-manager-i.label: Progression
government_service:goods-train-manager-i.text: It lists Senior Goods Train Manager at Level 6 through promotion by seniority-cum-suitability, and Senior Passenger Train Manager and Mail/Express Train Manager at Level 6 through promotion by suitability with the prescribed benchmark.

government_service:goods-train-manager-i.label: Progression
government_service:goods-train-manager-i.text: Senior Goods Train Manager — Level 6; promotion channel stated as seniority-cum-suitability.

government_service:goods-train-manager-i.label: Progression
government_service:goods-train-manager-i.text: Senior Passenger Train Manager — Level 6; promotion by suitability with the prescribed benchmark.

government_service:goods-train-manager-i.label: Progression
government_service:goods-train-manager-i.text: Mail/Express Train Manager — Level 6; promotion by suitability with the prescribed benchmark.

government_service:goods-train-manager-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:goods-train-manager-i.text: In CEN 05/2024, Goods Train Manager was shown at 7th CPC Level 5 with initial basic pay of ₹29,200.

government_service:goods-train-manager-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:goods-train-manager-i.text: CEN 05/2024 baseline: Level 5, initial basic pay ₹29,200.

government_service:government-architect.label: Compensation context
government_service:government-architect.text: For central-government posts, the Seventh Central Pay Commission pay matrix remains the relevant published framework for basic pay levels, while Dearness Allowance is revised separately by government order; the Department of Expenditure lists a revision effective 1 January 2026.

government_service:government-dental-sur.label: Pay context
government_service:government-dental-sur.text: For example, a 2022 Mizoram PSC advertisement listed Level 10 at ₹56,100–₹1,24,500 for Grade-III Dental Surgeon posts, while a 2025 NHM Wayanad contractual notice listed ₹41,000 per month.

government_service:government-dental-sur.label: Compensation context
government_service:government-dental-sur.text: As dated reference points only: Mizoram PSC’s 2022 Grade-III Dental Surgeon advertisement stated Pay Level 10 of ₹56,100–₹1,24,500; a 2025 NHM Wayanad notice stated ₹41,000 for a Dental Surgeon vacancy; and the Delhi Health Service draft listed Level 10 at ₹56,100–₹1,77,500 for its Dental Surgeon entry grade.

government_service:government-physiother.label: Typical central recruitment benchmark
government_service:government-physiother.text: In Railway Recruitment Board CEN 04/2024, Physiotherapist Grade II was advertised at Pay Level 6 with a Bachelor’s Degree in Physiotherapy and two years of practical physiotherapy experience in a government or private hospital with at least 100 beds.

government_service:government-physiother.label: Pay context
government_service:government-physiother.text: The 2024 RRB Physiotherapist Grade II notice listed Pay Level 6 with an initial pay figure of ₹35,400;

government_service:government-physiother.label: Pay context
government_service:government-physiother.text: Delhi’s 2024 draft rules also showed Level 6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400.

government_service:government-physiother.label: Compensation context
government_service:government-physiother.text: As dated examples, RRB CEN 04/2024 listed Physiotherapist Grade II at Level 6 with ₹35,400 initial pay, and Delhi’s 2024 draft physiotherapist rules listed Level 6 in the ₹35,400–₹1,12,400 pay matrix.

government_service:government-radiograph.label: A major central-government recruitment route
government_service:government-radiograph.text: Railway Recruitment Boards recruit this role under the title “Radiographer X-Ray Technician.” In RRB Centralised Employment Notice (CEN) 04/2024, the post was listed at Pay Level 5, with medical standard B1.

government_service:government-radiograph.label: Pay context, not a salary guarantee
government_service:government-radiograph.text: RRB CEN 04/2024 showed initial basic pay of ₹29,200 for Radiographer X-Ray Technician at Pay Level 5.

government_service:government-radiograph.label: Compensation context
government_service:government-radiograph.text: As a dated central-government example, RRB CEN 04/2024 listed Radiographer X-Ray Technician at Pay Level 5 with ₹29,200 stated as pay.

government_service:health-and-malaria-in.label: Pay level and medical standard
government_service:health-and-malaria-in.text: In the 2024 RRB paramedical notice, the post was listed at 7th CPC Pay Level 6, with an initial basic pay of ₹35,400 and medical standard C1.

government_service:health-and-malaria-in.label: Entry through RRB paramedical recruitment
government_service:health-and-malaria-in.text: The latest verified national notice in the available official record is CEN 04/2024; it listed Health & Malaria Inspector Grade III as a Level 6 paramedical post.

government_service:health-and-malaria-in.label: Compensation context
government_service:health-and-malaria-in.text: For the 2024 RRB paramedical recruitment cycle, Health & Malaria Inspector Grade III was advertised at 7th CPC Pay Level 6 with an initial basic pay of ₹35,400.

government_service:health-and-malaria-in.label: Compensation context
government_service:health-and-malaria-in.text: Actual take-home pay varies with admissible allowances, place of posting, deductions, and future government pay decisions; the 2024 figure should therefore be used as historical recruitment context rather than a current salary quote.

government_service:health-and-malaria-in.label: Compensation context
government_service:health-and-malaria-in.text: Vacancy counts, zone-wise allocation, eligibility dates, and recruitment timelines change between notifications. 2024 notification context: Pay Level 6; initial basic pay ₹35,400.

government_service:homoeopathic-medical-.label: Compensation context
government_service:homoeopathic-medical-.text: As a dated example, Odisha’s 27 December 2023 cadre-restructuring resolution placed base-level Homoeopathic Medical Officer posts at ₹44,900–₹142,400 under Level 10 of the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay Rules, 2017; it placed Senior HMO and district-level promotional posts at ₹56,100–₹177,500 under Level 12.

government_service:indian-administrative.label: Training and career progression
government_service:indian-administrative.text: The IAS pay rules set out a grade structure from Junior Scale (Level 10) through Senior Time Scale (Level 11), Junior Administrative Grade (Level 12), Selection Grade (Level 13), Super Time Scale (Level 14), Higher Administrative Grade (Level 15), Apex Scale (Level 17), and the Cabinet Secretary grade (Level 18).

government_service:indian-administrative.label: Compensation context
government_service:indian-administrative.text: Under those rules, a direct recruit’s initial basic pay is fixed at the first cell of Pay Matrix Level 10 (Junior Scale); the rules then specify higher pay levels for subsequent IAS grades.

government_service:indian-administrative.label: Compensation context
government_service:indian-administrative.text: Entry grade for a direct recruit under the 2016 rules: Junior Scale, Pay Matrix Level 10.

government_service:indian-administrative.label: Compensation context
government_service:indian-administrative.text: Higher IAS grades in the rules span Levels 11–15, Level 17, and Level 18 for the Cabinet Secretary grade.

government_service:indian-foreign-servic.label: Entry pay context
government_service:indian-foreign-servic.text: The Indian Foreign Service (Recruitment, Cadre and Seniority) Rules, 2020 list Junior Time Scale—the direct-recruit entry grade—as Pay Matrix Level 10, ₹56,100–₹177,500 basic pay.

government_service:indian-foreign-servic.label: Compensation context
government_service:indian-foreign-servic.text: The Indian Foreign Service (Recruitment, Cadre and Seniority) Rules, 2020 specify Junior Time Scale (the direct-recruit entry grade) at Level 10, with a basic-pay range of ₹56,100–₹177,500;

government_service:indian-foreign-servic.label: Compensation context
government_service:indian-foreign-servic.text: Grade II at Level 15; and Grade I at Level 17.

government_service:indian-foreign-servic.label: Compensation context
government_service:indian-foreign-servic.text: Direct-recruit entry grade in the 2020 rules: Junior Time Scale, Level 10.

government_service:indian-police-service.label: Pay context
government_service:indian-police-service.text: Under the IPS (Pay) Rules, 2016, direct recruits enter Junior Scale, Level 10 of the Pay Matrix.

government_service:indian-police-service.label: Pay context
government_service:indian-police-service.text: The first Level 10 cell shown in the notified matrix is ₹56,100 basic pay per month; take-home pay varies with applicable allowances, deductions, posting and later government revisions.

government_service:indian-police-service.label: Career progression and development
government_service:indian-police-service.text: The IPS Pay Rules, 2016 set out the service’s pay levels and minimum service-based eligibility milestones for several grades.

government_service:indian-police-service.label: Career progression and development
government_service:indian-police-service.text: They identify Junior Scale as Level 10;

government_service:indian-police-service.label: Career progression and development
government_service:indian-police-service.text: IGP as Level 14; and higher levels for ADGP, HAG+ and Apex Scale roles.

government_service:indian-police-service.label: Compensation context
government_service:indian-police-service.text: The notified IPS (Pay) Rules, 2016 place direct recruits in Junior Scale, Level 10 and state that a direct recruit’s initial pay is fixed at the minimum or first cell of Level 10.

government_service:indian-police-service.label: Compensation context
government_service:indian-police-service.text: The rule’s Schedule III shows ₹56,100 as the first Level 10 basic-pay cell, effective from January 1, 2016.

government_service:indian-police-service.label: Compensation context
government_service:indian-police-service.text: Direct-recruit basic-pay starting point in the cited 2016 matrix: Level 10, first cell ₹56,100 per month.

government_service:indian-police-service.label: Compensation context
government_service:indian-police-service.text: Promotion/grade levels in the cited rules extend from Level 11 through Level 17.

government_service:indian-police-service.label: Compensation context
government_service:indian-police-service.text: Do not treat the 2016 matrix figure as current net pay or as a universal salary quote; allowances and revisions are variable.

government_service:indian-revenue-servic.label: Typical direct-recruit entry post
government_service:indian-revenue-servic.text: For the Customs & Indirect Taxes stream, the corresponding entry-grade designations include Assistant Commissioner/Assistant Director; the CBIC civil list identifies this grade as Pay Matrix Level 10.

government_service:indian-revenue-servic.label: Career progression
government_service:indian-revenue-servic.text: The Customs & Indirect Taxes civil list similarly identifies a hierarchy from Assistant Commissioner/Assistant Director at Level 10 through Deputy Commissioner, Joint Commissioner, Additional Commissioner, Commissioner, Principal Commissioner, Chief Commissioner and Principal Chief Commissioner/Director-General grades.

government_service:indian-revenue-servic.label: Compensation context
government_service:indian-revenue-servic.text: As a current pay-structure reference, the entry Assistant Commissioner/Assistant Director grade in the IRS (Customs & Indirect Taxes) civil list is Pay Matrix Level 10; the Seventh Central Pay Commission pay matrix shows a Level 10 starting basic pay of ₹56,100.

government_service:indian-revenue-servic.label: Compensation context
government_service:indian-revenue-servic.text: Entry-level basic-pay context: Pay Matrix Level 10, with ₹56,100 as the Level 10 starting basic pay in the Seventh CPC matrix.

government_service:inspector-of-income-t.label: Pay context
government_service:inspector-of-income-t.text: The CGLE 2026 notice placed the post at Pay Level 7, with the stated pay-matrix range of ₹44,900–₹1,42,400.

government_service:inspector-of-income-t.label: Progression
government_service:inspector-of-income-t.text: For example, a July 1, 2024 order of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax for Andhra Pradesh and Telangana records promotion of an Inspector of Income Tax to Income Tax Officer, a Group B Gazetted post in Pay Level 8.

government_service:inspector-of-income-t.label: Compensation context
government_service:inspector-of-income-t.text: As stated in SSC’s CGLE 2026 notice, Inspector of Income Tax is in Pay Level 7, whose listed matrix range is ₹44,900–₹1,42,400.

government_service:inspector-of-income-t.label: Compensation context
government_service:inspector-of-income-t.text: The ₹44,900 figure is the entry basic pay in the Level 7 matrix, not a complete monthly salary figure.

government_service:inspector-of-income-t.label: Compensation context
government_service:inspector-of-income-t.text: Dated official context used here: CGLE 2026 lists Pay Level 7 at ₹44,900–₹1,42,400.

government_service:inspector-of-income-t.label: Compensation context
government_service:inspector-of-income-t.text: Promotion to ITO can move an employee to Pay Level 8, as shown in the cited 2024 departmental promotion order.

government_service:judge-advocate-genera.label: Compensation context
government_service:judge-advocate-genera.text: The 124th-course notification lists a cadet stipend of ₹56,100 per month during OTA training.

government_service:judge-advocate-genera.label: Compensation context
government_service:judge-advocate-genera.text: On commissioning, it lists Lieutenant pay at Level 10, ₹56,100–₹177,500, and fixed Military Service Pay of ₹15,500 per month for ranks from Lieutenant through Brigadier.

government_service:judge-advocate-genera.label: Compensation context
government_service:judge-advocate-genera.text: Training stipend stated in the 2026 124th-course notice: ₹56,100 per month.

government_service:judge-advocate-genera.label: Compensation context
government_service:judge-advocate-genera.text: Lieutenant pay matrix stated in that notice: Level 10, ₹56,100–₹177,500.

government_service:judge-advocate-genera.label: Compensation context
government_service:judge-advocate-genera.text: Military Service Pay stated in that notice: ₹15,500 per month for Lieutenant to Brigadier.

government_service:judicial-magistrate-f.label: Statutory sentencing ceiling
government_service:judicial-magistrate-f.text: Under BNSS section 23, a Court of Magistrate of the First Class may impose imprisonment up to three years, a fine up to ₹50,000, both, or community service, subject to the court's jurisdiction and the applicable offence provisions.

government_service:judicial-magistrate-f.label: Core judicial-magisterial responsibilities
government_service:judicial-magistrate-f.text: The statutory sentencing power of an JMFC is limited to imprisonment up to three years, fine up to ₹50,000, both, or community service.

government_service:judicial-magistrate-f.label: Compensation context: state pay matrices, not a single national salary
government_service:judicial-magistrate-f.text: As a dated illustration rather than a current universal rate, a Madhya Pradesh High Court posting order dated December 5, 2023 recorded newly appointed Civil Judges (Junior Division), Entry Level, on a temporary basis in the ₹77,840–₹136,520 Level J-1 scale.

government_service:judicial-magistrate-f.label: Compensation context: state pay matrices, not a single national salary
government_service:judicial-magistrate-f.text: A Sikkim Judicial Service recruitment notice for Civil Judge-cum-Judicial Magistrate (Grade III) likewise advertised Pay Matrix J-1 at ₹77,840 plus admissible allowances.

government_service:junior-account-assist.label: Pay context
government_service:junior-account-assist.text: CEN 05/2024 listed JAACT at Pay Level 5 of the 7th CPC pay matrix, with initial basic pay of ₹29,200.

government_service:junior-account-assist.label: Pay and compensation context
government_service:junior-account-assist.text: For dated context, the official CEN 05/2024 indicative notice placed JAACT in Level 5 under the 7th CPC pay matrix and stated an initial basic pay of ₹29,200.

government_service:junior-account-assist.label: Pay and compensation context
government_service:junior-account-assist.text: Dated official notice context: Pay Level 5, initial basic pay ₹29,200 under CEN 05/2024.

government_service:junior-clerk-cum-typi.text: CEN 06/2024 placed Junior Clerk Cum Typist at 7th CPC Pay Level 2, with an initial basic pay of ₹19,900 and medical standard C2.

government_service:junior-clerk-cum-typi.label: Pay context
government_service:junior-clerk-cum-typi.text: For context only, CEN 06/2024 specified 7th CPC Pay Level 2 and initial basic pay of ₹19,900 for Junior Clerk Cum Typist.

government_service:junior-clerk-cum-typi.label: Pay context
government_service:junior-clerk-cum-typi.text: Dated CEN 06/2024 pay matrix position: 7th CPC Level 2.

government_service:junior-engineer-centr.label: Post classification and pay level
government_service:junior-engineer-centr.text: For the SSC JE 2024 recruitment, the advertised posts were Group ‘B’ (Non-Gazetted), Non-Ministerial posts at 7th CPC Pay Level 6, with the published pay-matrix range of ₹35,400–₹1,12,400.

government_service:junior-engineer-centr.label: Compensation context
government_service:junior-engineer-centr.text: As dated context rather than a current guaranteed offer: the Government’s SSC JE 2024 announcement placed the advertised JE posts at 7th CPC Pay Level 6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400 in the pay matrix.

government_service:junior-engineer-india.label: Pay context
government_service:junior-engineer-india.text: In CEN 03/2024, JE was listed at Level 6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix with initial basic pay of ₹35,400 plus admissible allowances.

government_service:junior-engineer-india.label: Promotion context
government_service:junior-engineer-india.text: Senior Section Engineer (SSE) is an evidenced progression destination in some railway cadres: an official Southern Railway order records promotion from JE/Signal in Level 6 to SSE/Signal in Level 7.

government_service:junior-engineer-india.label: Progression and professional development
government_service:junior-engineer-india.text: An official Southern Railway promotion order documents JEs in Signal & Telecommunications being promoted from Level 6 to Senior Section Engineer/Signal in Level 7, subject to the applicable selection and service conditions.

government_service:junior-engineer-india.label: Compensation context
government_service:junior-engineer-india.text: CEN 03/2024 listed Junior Engineer in Pay Level 6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix with initial basic pay of ₹35,400 and stated that other allowances would be admissible at the time.

government_service:junior-engineer-india.label: Compensation context
government_service:junior-engineer-india.text: This is basic-pay context from a 2024 notice, not an estimate of in-hand salary.

government_service:junior-engineer-india.label: Compensation context
government_service:junior-engineer-india.text: CEN 03/2024 reference: Level 6, initial basic pay ₹35,400.

government_service:junior-engineer-state.label: Pay context
government_service:junior-engineer-state.text: As dated official examples, Puducherry PWD’s JE (Civil) rules list Level 6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400, while a November 2025 West Bengal PWD appointment notification lists JE (Civil) in WBS ROPA 2019 Pay Matrix Level 12 with admissible allowances.

government_service:junior-engineer-state.label: Compensation context: pay matrices and allowances vary by state and cadre
government_service:junior-engineer-state.text: For dated comparison only, Puducherry PWD’s notified JE (Civil) recruitment rules show Pay Matrix Level 6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400.

government_service:junior-engineer-state.label: Compensation context: pay matrices and allowances vary by state and cadre
government_service:junior-engineer-state.text: A West Bengal PWD appointment notification dated November 25, 2025 places JE (Civil) in WBS ROPA 2019 Pay Matrix Level 12 and states that other allowances are admissible.

government_service:junior-statistical-of.label: Service and classification
government_service:junior-statistical-of.text: MoSPI’s Subordinate Statistical Service (SSS) documentation describes the corresponding Level 6 statistical-function post as Group B, non-gazetted and non-ministerial.

government_service:junior-statistical-of.label: Pay context
government_service:junior-statistical-of.text: The SSC CGL 2025 notice placed JSO in Pay Level 6, whose published pay-matrix range was ₹35,400–₹1,12,400.

government_service:junior-statistical-of.label: Entry through SSC CGL
government_service:junior-statistical-of.text: For people already employed in recognised statistical feeder posts, SSS documentation also provides a limited internal promotion/absorption channel to the Level 6 statistical post.

government_service:junior-statistical-of.label: Workplace and mobility
government_service:junior-statistical-of.text: Its cadre documentation lists Level 6 and Level 7 statistical posts across many participating central ministries, departments and organisations, while MoSPI remains the cadre-controlling authority.

government_service:junior-statistical-of.label: Career progression
government_service:junior-statistical-of.text: The established next grade in the SSS structure is Senior Statistical Officer (SSO), a Group B gazetted Level 7 post.

government_service:junior-statistical-of.label: Career progression
government_service:junior-statistical-of.text: MoSPI’s published SSS schedule states that Level 6 Statistical Officers are eligible for promotion to SSO after five years of regular service, through selection on the recommendation of the Departmental Promotion Committee.

government_service:junior-statistical-of.label: Career progression
government_service:junior-statistical-of.text: The terminology in SSS material has at times described the Level 6 post as Statistical Officer/erstwhile JSO, while SSC’s CGL notices continue to recruit it as JSO.

government_service:junior-statistical-of.label: Career progression
government_service:junior-statistical-of.text: A MoSPI promotion order illustrates the path in practice: it records promotion of a JSO in Level 6 to SSO in Level 7, effective on assumption of charge.

government_service:junior-statistical-of.label: Career progression
government_service:junior-statistical-of.text: Progression: promotion to Senior Statistical Officer / Level 7, subject to the governing rules and selection process.

government_service:junior-statistical-of.label: Compensation context
government_service:junior-statistical-of.text: As published in SSC’s CGL 2025 notice, JSO was a Pay Level 6 post with a stated basic-pay matrix range of ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400.

government_service:junior-statistical-of.label: Compensation context
government_service:junior-statistical-of.text: Published CGL 2025 basic-pay context: Pay Level 6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400.

government_service:junior-statistical-of.label: Compensation context
government_service:junior-statistical-of.text: Promotion to the documented SSO grade is associated with Pay Level 7 in MoSPI’s SSS material.

government_service:laboratory-assistant-.label: Pay context
government_service:laboratory-assistant-.text: In CEN 04/2024, Laboratory Assistant Grade II was a 7th CPC Pay Level 3 post with an initial basic pay of ₹21,700.

government_service:laboratory-assistant-.label: Progression context
government_service:laboratory-assistant-.text: As a current comparison point, CEN 04/2024 listed Laboratory Superintendent at Pay Level 6 with a B.Sc.-based laboratory qualification route, which illustrates the higher qualification profile for that separately recruited post.

government_service:laboratory-assistant-.label: Progression context
government_service:laboratory-assistant-.text: Laboratory Superintendent is a distinct higher-level paramedical post in the 2024 RRB notice, with B.Sc.-based eligibility rather than the entry-level 10+2-plus-DMLT route.

government_service:laboratory-assistant-.label: Compensation context
government_service:laboratory-assistant-.text: For dated context, CEN 04/2024 placed Laboratory Assistant Grade II at Pay Level 3 under the 7th CPC and stated an initial basic pay of ₹21,700.

government_service:laboratory-assistant-.label: Compensation context
government_service:laboratory-assistant-.text: CEN 04/2024 context: 7th CPC Pay Level 3; initial basic pay ₹21,700.

government_service:lance-naik-indian-arm.label: Progression and promotion context
government_service:lance-naik-indian-arm.text: A Ministry of Defence answer to Parliament, published on January 2, 2018, states that Indian Army JCOs/ORs receive Modified Assured Career Progression (MACP) financial upgradations after 8, 16 and 24 years of service, with the next higher pay level on receipt of an upgradation.

government_service:legal-manager-in-a-ps.label: Compensation context
government_service:legal-manager-in-a-ps.text: As dated context only, BEL’s March 11, 2026 permanent-recruitment advertisement listed ₹50,000–₹1,60,000 with 3% annual increment for Assistant Manager (Legal), E-III, and ₹60,000–₹1,80,000 with 3% annual increment for Deputy Manager (Legal), E-IV.

government_service:legal-officer-in-a-ps.label: Compensation context
government_service:legal-officer-in-a-ps.text: As a dated illustration, POWERGRID’s 2025 Officer Trainee (Law) notice stated basic pay of ₹40,000 during training and absorption as Officer (Law), E-2, on ₹50,000–₹1,60,000 IDA scale; it also stated approximate CTC of ₹11 lakh during training and ₹22.50 lakh after successful training, subject to location and terms.

government_service:legal-officer-in-a-ps.label: Compensation context
government_service:legal-officer-in-a-ps.text: As dated context only, POWERGRID’s 2025 Officer Trainee (Law) notice stated ₹40,000 basic pay during training with IDA, HRA, and 12% perks on basic pay; after training it stated E-2 pay scale of ₹50,000–₹1,60,000 (IDA).

government_service:legal-officer-in-a-ps.label: Compensation context
government_service:legal-officer-in-a-ps.text: It also listed approximate annual CTC of ₹11.00 lakh during training and ₹22.50 lakh after successful completion, expressly noting that CTC varied by posting location and terms.

government_service:legal-officer-in-a-ps.label: Compensation context
government_service:legal-officer-in-a-ps.text: NHPC’s cited recruitment likewise placed Trainee Officer (Law) at E-2 ₹50,000–₹1,60,000 with allowances and benefits under company rules.

government_service:lieutenant-in-the-ind.label: Compensation context
government_service:lieutenant-in-the-ind.text: The October 2026 JAG notification stated that, upon successful commissioning, pay would be fixed at the first cell of Pay Level 10; it also listed Military Service Pay of ₹15,500 per month for ranks from Lieutenant through Brigadier.

government_service:lieutenant-in-the-ind.label: Compensation context
government_service:lieutenant-in-the-ind.text: Dated 2026 notification context: commissioning pay was to begin at the first cell of Pay Level 10.

government_service:lieutenant-in-the-ind.label: Compensation context
government_service:lieutenant-in-the-ind.text: Dated 2026 notification context: Military Service Pay was listed as ₹15,500 per month from Lieutenant to Brigadier.

government_service:loco-pilot-goods-in-i.label: Employer and cadre
government_service:loco-pilot-goods-in-i.text: An official North East Frontier Railway avenue-of-chart document places it in the ALP/LP/LI cadre and identifies it as a Level-6 post.

government_service:loco-pilot-goods-in-i.label: Departmental route from Assistant Loco Pilot
government_service:loco-pilot-goods-in-i.text: The same chart states that prescribed footplate experience, aptitude testing where prescribed, and pre-promotional course/trainee training with a written test are mandatory for promotions to the relevant Level-6 posts.

government_service:loco-pilot-goods-in-i.label: Progression beyond Loco Pilot (Goods)
government_service:loco-pilot-goods-in-i.text: It then shows Chief Loco Inspector at Level 7, with a general selection process and a requirement of 75,000 km of actual driving experience as a Loco Pilot.

government_service:loco-pilot-goods-in-i.label: Pay and running-allowance context
government_service:loco-pilot-goods-in-i.text: The official avenue chart classifies Loco Pilot (Goods) at Pay Level 6, while Railway Board/railway circular material lists it among loco running staff for kilometreage allowance and allowance-in-lieu-of-kilometreage purposes.

government_service:loco-pilot-goods-in-i.label: Pay and running-allowance context
government_service:loco-pilot-goods-in-i.text: The cited circular shows Level 6 for the role and a kilometreage allowance rate of ₹520 per 100 km, with ₹832 allowance in lieu of kilometreage per 160 km; these figures must be treated as dated rule context rather than a current take-home-pay quote.

government_service:loco-pilot-goods-in-i.label: Pay and running-allowance context
government_service:loco-pilot-goods-in-i.text: A separate official Railway document records an additional monthly allowance of ₹750 for Loco Pilot (Goods).

government_service:lower-divisional-cler.label: Pay context
government_service:lower-divisional-cler.text: The SSC CHSL 2025 notice placed LDC/JSA at Central Pay Matrix Level 2, ₹19,900–₹63,200.

government_service:lower-divisional-cler.label: Compensation context
government_service:lower-divisional-cler.text: As published in SSC’s CHSL 2025 notice, LDC/JSA carries Pay Matrix Level 2, with a stated range of ₹19,900–₹63,200.

government_service:lower-divisional-cler.label: Compensation context
government_service:lower-divisional-cler.text: Published Level 2 range in that notice: ₹19,900–₹63,200.

government_service:multi-tasking-staff-c.label: Pay context
government_service:multi-tasking-staff-c.text: The 2025 SSC notice placed MTS in Pay Level 1 under the 7th Central Pay Commission pay matrix.

government_service:multi-tasking-staff-c.label: Pay context
government_service:multi-tasking-staff-c.text: The CCS (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 show Level 1 beginning at ₹18,000 basic pay; actual take-home pay changes with admissible allowances, location, deductions, and later government revisions.

government_service:multi-tasking-staff-c.label: Compensation context
government_service:multi-tasking-staff-c.text: The SSC MTS Examination 2025 notice placed the post in Pay Level 1 of the 7th Central Pay Commission pay matrix.

government_service:multi-tasking-staff-c.label: Compensation context
government_service:multi-tasking-staff-c.text: Under the Central Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016, Level 1 starts at ₹18,000 basic pay.

government_service:multi-tasking-staff-c.label: Compensation context
government_service:multi-tasking-staff-c.text: Reference pay level: Level 1 under the 7th CPC pay matrix.

government_service:multi-tasking-staff-c.label: Compensation context
government_service:multi-tasking-staff-c.text: Reference starting basic pay: ₹18,000 under the 2016 CCS revised-pay rules.

government_service:munsiff-magistrate-in.label: Pay context
government_service:munsiff-magistrate-in.text: Kerala’s 2024–25 Budget staff appendix listed the designation “Munsiff” in the Judicial Services Department with a scale of ₹27,700–44,770.

government_service:munsiff-magistrate-in.label: Compensation is state- and date-dependent
government_service:munsiff-magistrate-in.text: As a dated reference point, Kerala’s 2024–25 Budget staff appendix listed “Munsiff” under the Judicial Services Department on ₹27,700–44,770, and listed higher judicial designations on different scales.

government_service:nursing-officer-gover.label: Role
government_service:nursing-officer-gover.text: In AIIMS NORCET-8, AIIMS described the recruitment as for Nursing Officer posts at Pay Level 7 for AIIMS New Delhi and other participating AIIMS, subject to vacancies.

government_service:nursing-officer-gover.label: Pay context
government_service:nursing-officer-gover.text: ESIC’s 2020 Nursing Officer recruitment regulations list the post at 7th CPC Pay Level 7 (₹44,900–₹1,42,400); the 2025 AIIMS NORCET notice likewise advertised Nursing Officer posts at Level 7 and stated that usual admissible Central Government allowances apply.

government_service:nursing-officer-gover.label: Compensation context
government_service:nursing-officer-gover.text: As dated central-government reference points, ESIC’s 2020 regulations list Nursing Officer as Group B, non-ministerial at 7th CPC Pay Level 7, with a published pay-matrix range of ₹44,900–₹1,42,400.

government_service:nursing-officer-gover.label: Compensation context
government_service:nursing-officer-gover.text: AIIMS NORCET-8, advertised in February 2025, also described Nursing Officer posts at Level 7.

government_service:nursing-officer-gover.label: Compensation context
government_service:nursing-officer-gover.text: Treat the cited ₹44,900–₹1,42,400 Level 7 range as ESIC’s 2020 regulatory context, not a guaranteed current take-home amount for every government Nursing Officer post.

government_service:nursing-supervisor.label: Compensation context
government_service:nursing-supervisor.text: As a dated official example, the Department of Health Research’s BMHRC Nursing Supervisor rules state Pay Level 8 with basic pay of ₹47,600.

government_service:nursing-supervisor.label: Compensation context
government_service:nursing-supervisor.text: Ladakh’s 2025 gazette notification lists the combined Sister/Nursing Supervisor post at Level 6E, ₹35,900–₹113,500.

government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.label: Cadre structure
government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.text: The May 2024 cadre review recorded IRRS Group ‘A’ Junior Time Scale at Pay Matrix Level 10, with higher grades through Senior Time Scale, Junior Administrative Grade, Senior Administrative Grade, and Higher Administrative Grade.

government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.label: Career progression
government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.text: The 2024 IRRS Group ‘A’ cadre review provides the clearest official current framework for progression: Junior Time Scale (JTS) is Pay Matrix Level 10;

government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.label: Career progression
government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.text: Senior Administrative Grade is Level 14; and Higher Administrative Grade is Level 15.

government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.label: Career progression
