government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.text: Published DoT seniority material also shows working designations at higher levels, including Assistant Wireless Adviser/Engineer-in-Charge at Level 11 and Deputy Wireless Adviser/Deputy Director at Level 12.

government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.label: Career progression
government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.text: Entry grade: Junior Time Scale (JTS), Pay Matrix Level 10.

government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.label: Compensation context
government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.text: As of the May 2024 IRRS cadre-review notification, the entry JTS grade is mapped to Pay Matrix Level 10, while the service’s senior grades extend through Level 15.

government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.label: Compensation context
government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.text: For context on later grades, a DoT provisional seniority list dated January 1, 2025 identifies Assistant Wireless Adviser/Engineer-in-Charge at Level 11 and Deputy Wireless Adviser/Deputy Director at Level 12.

government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.label: Compensation context
government_service:officer-in-indian-rad.text: Entry context: JTS, Pay Matrix Level 10, according to the 2024 IRRS cadre review.

government_service:officer-in-indian-tel.label: Entry pay context
government_service:officer-in-indian-tel.text: A DoT appointment offer dated July 17, 2025 placed Assistant Divisional Engineer Telecom (JTS of ITS Group ‘A’) at Level 10 in the 7th Central Pay Commission matrix: ₹56,100–₹177,500 plus applicable allowances.

government_service:officer-in-indian-tel.label: Compensation context
government_service:officer-in-indian-tel.text: The most directly evidenced entry-pay reference located is DoT’s July 17, 2025 offer for Assistant Divisional Engineer Telecom (JTS of ITS Group ‘A’): Level 10, ₹56,100–₹177,500 in the 7th Central Pay Commission pay matrix, plus allowances.

government_service:officer-in-indian-tel.label: Compensation context
government_service:officer-in-indian-tel.text: Use the cited Level 10 figure as historical appointment-order context dated July 17, 2025.

government_service:paramedic-government.label: National skills classification
government_service:paramedic-government.text: EMT-Basic is listed at NSQF Level 4.

government_service:pharmacist-in-indian-.label: Pay context
government_service:pharmacist-in-indian-.text: The official CEN 04/2024 paramedical recruitment listed Pharmacist (Entry Grade) at 7th CPC Pay Level 5 with an initial pay of ₹29,200.

government_service:pharmacist-in-indian-.label: Entry route and eligibility
government_service:pharmacist-in-indian-.text: Railway Board’s instruction for Pharmacist Grade III in Level 5 now requires a Bachelor Degree in Pharmacy (Allopathic) or Doctor of Pharmacy, from a Central- or State-government-recognised university or institute, and registration as a pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act, 1948.

government_service:pharmacist-in-indian-.label: Compensation context
government_service:pharmacist-in-indian-.text: For dated reference only, the official CEN 04/2024 notice placed Pharmacist (Entry Grade) in Pay Level 5 of the 7th Central Pay Commission matrix with initial pay of ₹29,200.

government_service:pharmacist-in-indian-.label: Compensation context
government_service:pharmacist-in-indian-.text: The July 2026 Railway Board qualification instruction likewise identifies Pharmacist Grade III as a Level 5 post, but it does not establish a new rupee starting-pay figure.

government_service:pharmacist-in-indian-.label: Compensation context
government_service:pharmacist-in-indian-.text: Dated benchmark: CEN 04/2024 showed Level 5 and ₹29,200 initial pay.

government_service:police-constable-stat.label: Pay context
government_service:police-constable-stat.text: As dated context, Goa Staff Selection Commission’s Advertisement No. 02 of 2026 listed Police Constable (Male/Female) in Pay Level 2; candidates should rely on the current notification for pay, allowances, probation pay, and service conditions.

government_service:police-constable-stat.label: Compensation context
government_service:police-constable-stat.text: As a dated example only, Goa Staff Selection Commission’s Advertisement No. 02 of 2026 listed Police Constable (Male/Female) at Pay Level 2.

government_service:postal-assistant-sort.label: Current SSC examination context
government_service:postal-assistant-sort.text: The SSC Combined Graduate Level Examination 2025 notice lists Postal Assistant/Sorting Assistant in the Department of Posts as a Pay Level-4 Group ‘C’ post with an advertised age band of 18–27 years.

government_service:postal-assistant-sort.label: Pay context
government_service:postal-assistant-sort.text: The Department’s 2022 rules and SSC’s 2025 notice identify PA/SA at Pay Matrix Level 4, ₹25,500–81,100; this is the pay-matrix range, not a guaranteed in-hand salary.

government_service:postal-assistant-sort.label: Entry routes and eligibility
government_service:postal-assistant-sort.text: The official SSC Combined Graduate Level Examination 2025 notice lists PA/SA as a Department of Posts Group ‘C’ Level-4 post.

government_service:postal-assistant-sort.label: Compensation context
government_service:postal-assistant-sort.text: As of the cited 2025 SSC notice and the Department’s PA/SA recruitment rules, the post is shown at Pay Matrix Level 4: ₹25,500–81,100.

government_service:primary-teacher-in-a-.label: Historical pay context
government_service:primary-teacher-in-a-.text: KVS’s 2022 PRT direct-recruitment advertisement listed Pay Matrix Level 6, ₹35,400–₹112,400, with an upper age limit of 30 years before applicable relaxations.

government_service:primary-teacher-in-a-.label: Compensation context
government_service:primary-teacher-in-a-.text: The clearest official PRT pay figure located is from KVS Advertisement No. 16/2022, which specified Pay Matrix Level 6: ₹35,400–₹112,400 for direct-recruitment PRTs.

government_service:primary-teacher-in-a-.label: Pay and service conditions
government_service:primary-teacher-in-a-.text: As a dated example, Goa Staff Selection Commission’s 2026 Government Primary School Teacher advertisement listed Pay Level 6; this should not be treated as the scale in other states or future recruitments.

government_service:primary-teacher-in-a-.label: Compensation context
government_service:primary-teacher-in-a-.text: Section 23 of the RTE Act leaves teacher salary, allowances, and service conditions to what is prescribed, so these vary by state, appointing authority, pay revision, appointment type, and the vacancy’s terms.

government_service:primary-teacher-in-a-.label: Compensation context
government_service:primary-teacher-in-a-.text: As a dated illustration only, Goa Staff Selection Commission’s Advertisement No. 01 of 2026 for Government Primary School Teacher (Konkani Medium) listed “Level - 6” and applications from January 30, 2026 through February 20, 2026.

government_service:scientist-engineer-sc.label: Employment level
government_service:scientist-engineer-sc.text: In the 2025 ISRO ICRB Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ advertisements, the post was Level 10 of the Central Pay Matrix and a Group A Gazetted post at constituent ISRO centres.

government_service:scientist-engineer-sc.label: Starting-pay context
government_service:scientist-engineer-sc.text: In the 2025 advertisements, the minimum basic pay stated for Level 10 was ₹56,100 per month, with DA, HRA and transport allowance under extant rules.

government_service:scientist-engineer-sc.label: Compensation and benefits context
government_service:scientist-engineer-sc.text: As stated in the 2025 ICRB advertisements, appointment as Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’ was at Pay Matrix Level 10 with a minimum basic pay of ₹56,100 per month.

government_service:scientist-engineer-sc.label: Compensation and benefits context
government_service:scientist-engineer-sc.text: Use ₹56,100 per month only as the cited 2025 minimum basic-pay reference, not as a current estimate of total compensation.

government_service:section-officer-in-ce.label: CSS position
government_service:section-officer-in-ce.text: In the Central Secretariat Service (CSS), Section Officer is a Group ‘B’ Gazetted grade; official 2025 appointments describe the grade as Pay Level 8 in the 7th Central Pay Matrix.

government_service:section-officer-in-ce.label: Primary entry pattern
government_service:section-officer-in-ce.text: DoPT’s CSS recruitment page says direct recruitment to the SO level was discontinued after the 2003 restructuring, while SSC’s 2026 CGL notice lists ASO in CSS as a Pay Level 7 Group ‘B’ post.

government_service:section-officer-in-ce.label: Departmental advancement route
government_service:section-officer-in-ce.text: Gazette appointments for the 2024 LDCE record appointment to CSS SO Grade in Pay Level 8.

government_service:section-officer-in-ce.label: Pay context
government_service:section-officer-in-ce.text: For the CSS SO grade, the Level 8 pay-matrix range cited in a 2025 Gazette appointment was ₹47,600–₹1,51,100 as basic pay.

government_service:section-officer-in-ce.label: How to reach Section Officer in the Central Secretariat Service
government_service:section-officer-in-ce.text: SSC’s Combined Graduate Level Examination is the principal open-recruitment route into the CSS ASO post; its 2026 notice places ASO in CSS at Pay Level 7 and states that, for posts other than specified exceptions, a bachelor’s degree or equivalent is the essential qualification.

government_service:section-officer-in-ce.label: Compensation context
government_service:section-officer-in-ce.text: For CSS Section Officers, a 2025 Gazette appointment identifies the grade as Level 8 of the 7th Central Pay Matrix, with a basic-pay range of ₹47,600–₹1,51,100.

government_service:section-officer-in-ce.label: Compensation context
government_service:section-officer-in-ce.text: Use Pay Level 8 basic pay as the dated grade-pay reference, not as a monthly in-hand estimate.

government_service:security-assistant-b-.label: Pay-matrix context
government_service:security-assistant-b-.text: The B post’s pre-revised scale was PB-1 ₹5,200–20,200 plus grade pay ₹2,400.

government_service:security-assistant-b-.label: Pay-matrix context
government_service:security-assistant-b-.text: Under the Central Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 conversion table, grade pay ₹2,400 corresponds to Pay Matrix Level 4, whose published range is ₹25,500–81,100.

government_service:security-assistant-b-.label: Compensation context: Pay Matrix Level 4 mapping
government_service:security-assistant-b-.text: The DRDO rules published for Security Assistant ‘B’ used the pre-revised PB-1 scale of ₹5,200–20,200 with grade pay ₹2,400.

government_service:security-assistant-b-.label: Compensation context: Pay Matrix Level 4 mapping
government_service:security-assistant-b-.text: The Government of India’s Central Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 map grade pay ₹2,400 to Pay Matrix Level 4; the Level 4 table runs from ₹25,500 to ₹81,100 in basic pay.

government_service:security-assistant-b-.label: Compensation context: Pay Matrix Level 4 mapping
government_service:security-assistant-b-.text: This provides the structural pay reference for the grade, not a promise of a specific starting cell, gross salary or in-hand amount as of 2026-07-19.

government_service:security-assistant-b-.label: Compensation context: Pay Matrix Level 4 mapping
government_service:security-assistant-b-.text: Historical DRDO B scale: PB-1 ₹5,200–20,200 + grade pay ₹2,400. 7th-CPC conversion: grade pay ₹2,400 maps to Pay Matrix Level 4.

government_service:security-assistant-b-.label: Compensation context: Pay Matrix Level 4 mapping

government_service:senior-clerk-cum-typi.label: Pay level
government_service:senior-clerk-cum-typi.text: In CEN 05/2024, the post was in 7th CPC Pay Level 5 with stated initial basic pay of ₹29,200.

government_service:senior-clerk-cum-typi.label: Ministerial-cadre context
government_service:senior-clerk-cum-typi.text: An Indian Railways HRMS cadre-management document illustrates the ministerial staff hierarchy as Junior Clerk (Pay Level 2), Senior Clerk (Pay Level 5), Office Superintendent (Pay Level 6), and Chief Office Superintendent (Pay Level 7).

government_service:senior-clerk-cum-typi.label: Ministerial-cadre context
government_service:senior-clerk-cum-typi.text: It therefore provides useful context for the Senior Clerk cum Typist post as a Level-5 clerical position within a broader ministerial cadre.

government_service:senior-clerk-cum-typi.label: Ministerial-cadre context
government_service:senior-clerk-cum-typi.text: The cited HRMS material gives the Senior Clerk level as Level 5, Office Superintendent as Level 6, and Chief Office Superintendent as Level 7.

government_service:senior-clerk-cum-typi.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-clerk-cum-typi.text: The most recent detailed graduate NTPC notice located for this role, CEN 05/2024, listed Senior Clerk cum Typist in 7th CPC Pay Level 5 with initial basic pay of ₹29,200.

government_service:senior-clerk-cum-typi.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-clerk-cum-typi.text: CEN 05/2024: Pay Level 5; initial basic pay ₹29,200.

government_service:senior-commercial-cum.label: Pay level
government_service:senior-commercial-cum.text: The post is in 7th CPC Pay Level 5.

government_service:senior-commercial-cum.label: Pay level
government_service:senior-commercial-cum.text: The Railway Board cadre order shows the Level-5 pay-matrix range as ₹29,200–₹92,300; actual monthly earnings vary with applicable allowances, posting and government revisions.

government_service:senior-commercial-cum.label: Entry through RRB NTPC and internal promotion
government_service:senior-commercial-cum.text: In the 2019 NTPC recruitment, Senior Commercial cum Ticket Clerk required a university degree or equivalent, was classified at Level 5 and B-2 medical standard, and had an advertised direct-recruitment age range of 18–33 years as of July 1, 2019.

government_service:senior-commercial-cum.label: Career progression context
government_service:senior-commercial-cum.text: The Railway Board’s unified commercial-and-ticketing cadre order places Senior Commercial-cum-Ticket Clerk at Level 5.

government_service:senior-commercial-cum.label: Career progression context
government_service:senior-commercial-cum.text: In that structure, the next stated promotion grade is Chief Commercial-cum-Ticket Clerk at Level 6, followed by Commercial Superintendent at Level 7.

government_service:senior-commercial-cum.label: Career progression context
government_service:senior-commercial-cum.text: The same order describes the senior clerk grade as a 50% direct-recruitment and 50% promotion grade, while the Level-6 Chief Commercial-cum-Ticket Clerk and Level-7 Commercial Superintendent grades are shown as promotional grades.

government_service:senior-commercial-cum.label: Career progression context
government_service:senior-commercial-cum.text: Level 6: Chief Commercial-cum-Ticket Clerk, shown as a promotion-selection grade in the 2018 cadre structure.

government_service:senior-commercial-cum.label: Career progression context
government_service:senior-commercial-cum.text: Level 7: Commercial Superintendent, shown as a promotion non-selection grade in the 2018 cadre structure.

government_service:senior-commercial-cum.label: Pay context
government_service:senior-commercial-cum.text: As documented in the 2018 Railway Board cadre order and the 2019 NTPC notice, Senior Commercial cum Ticket Clerk is a 7th CPC Level-5 post with an initial basic pay of ₹29,200 in that recruitment context and a Level-5 pay-matrix range of ₹29,200–₹92,300.

government_service:senior-commercial-cum.label: Pay context
government_service:senior-commercial-cum.text: Historical/basic-pay reference: ₹29,200 at Level 5 in the 2019 RRB NTPC notice.

government_service:senior-commercial-cum.label: Pay context
government_service:senior-commercial-cum.text: Pay-matrix reference: ₹29,200–₹92,300 in the 2018 cadre order.

government_service:senior-legal-officer-.label: Pay context
government_service:senior-legal-officer-.text: As dated examples, GAIL’s 2025 E-2 Senior Officer (Law) notice listed ₹60,000–₹1,80,000, and an IndianOil Senior Law Officer notice listed the same scale plus variable allowances and benefits under corporation rules.

government_service:senior-legal-officer-.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-legal-officer-.text: GAIL’s 2025 advertisement listed a ₹60,000–₹1,80,000 pay scale for Senior Officer (Law), E-2.

government_service:senior-legal-officer-.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-legal-officer-.text: An IndianOil recruitment notice for Senior Law Officer listed a ₹60,000–₹1,80,000 scale, starting basic pay of ₹60,000 and a stated gross remuneration valuation of ₹19.51 lakh.

government_service:senior-secretariat-as.label: Post classification
government_service:senior-secretariat-as.text: In the SSC’s 2025 SSA/UDC Grade departmental-examination notice, the post is described as a Group ‘C’, non-gazetted post at Pay Level 4.

government_service:senior-secretariat-as.label: Pay context
government_service:senior-secretariat-as.text: As stated in the SSC notice published on June 5, 2026, the Level 4 pay-matrix range shown for SSA/UDC Grade is ₹25,500–₹81,100.

government_service:senior-secretariat-as.label: Progression and career context
government_service:senior-secretariat-as.text: The same rules identify SSA as Level 4 and JSA as the redesignated Lower Division Clerk grade.

government_service:senior-secretariat-as.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-secretariat-as.text: It identifies the grade as Pay Level 4, Group ‘C’, non-gazetted, and displays a pay-matrix range of ₹25,500–₹81,100.

government_service:senior-secretariat-as.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-secretariat-as.text: This range is a Level 4 basic-pay range under the framework referenced in that notice, not an offer of a fixed monthly in-hand amount.

government_service:senior-secretariat-as.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-secretariat-as.text: Reference point as of the June 5, 2026 SSC notice: Pay Level 4 basic-pay range ₹25,500–₹81,100.

government_service:senior-section-engine.label: Typical route from parent role
government_service:senior-section-engine.text: A documented Indian Railways promotion order promoted Junior Engineers (Signal) in Level 6 to Senior Section Engineers (Signal) in Level 7, supporting the canonical pathway of progression from Junior Engineer to SSE.

government_service:senior-section-engine.label: Pay-level context
government_service:senior-section-engine.text: In a 2021 Southern Railway promotion order, JE (Signal) Level 6 employees were promoted to SSE (Signal) Level 7.

government_service:senior-section-engine.label: Pay-level context
government_service:senior-section-engine.text: The Seventh Central Pay Commission pay matrix notified in 2016 shows ₹44,900 as the first basic-pay cell for Level 7; actual monthly remuneration depends on the employee’s pay cell, applicable allowances, place of posting, and later government orders.

government_service:senior-section-engine.label: Entry routes
government_service:senior-section-engine.text: Southern Railway’s 2021 order is a concrete example: JE (Signal) employees in Level 6 selected for promotion were appointed as SSE (Signal) in Level 7.

government_service:senior-section-engine.label: Progression
government_service:senior-section-engine.text: The official Southern Railway example shows JE (Signal) Level 6 personnel promoted to SSE (Signal) Level 7, with the order describing the change as a regular promotion and transfer where applicable.

government_service:senior-section-engine.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-section-engine.text: The Seventh Central Pay Commission matrix notified under the Central Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 places the first cell of Level 7 at ₹44,900 basic pay.

government_service:senior-section-engine.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-section-engine.text: A Southern Railway promotion order identifies SSE (Signal) as Level 7 and gives examples of promoted employees whose basic pay was ₹64,100 at the time of that 2021 order.

government_service:senior-section-engine.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-section-engine.text: SSE (Signal) was recorded as Pay Matrix Level 7 in a Southern Railway promotion order dated September 21, 2021.

government_service:senior-section-engine.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-section-engine.text: The 2016 central pay matrix’s Level 7 begins at ₹44,900 basic pay.

government_service:senior-stenographer-i.label: Recruitment routes
government_service:senior-stenographer-i.text: The Food & Public Distribution draft rules provide promotion from Junior Stenographer at Pay Level 4 after ten years of regular service (with transitional provisions), whereas the NIT model rules provide promotion first, then deputation, then direct recruitment if those routes fail.

government_service:senior-stenographer-i.label: Pay context
government_service:senior-stenographer-i.text: As dated official examples, the Food & Public Distribution 2024 draft rules list Pay Level 6 (₹35,400–₹1,12,400), and MPEDA’s 2025 recruitment-rule proposal also lists Pay Level 6.

government_service:senior-stenographer-i.label: Entry routes and eligibility
government_service:senior-stenographer-i.text: The Department of Food & Public Distribution’s 2024 draft rules specify promotion from Junior Stenographer at Level 4 after ten years’ regular service, while MPEDA’s proposal similarly specifies promotion from Junior Stenographer after ten years and a 120 w.p.m. shorthand speed test.

government_service:senior-stenographer-i.label: Career progression
government_service:senior-stenographer-i.text: A typical step is from Junior Stenographer to Senior Stenographer: the Food & Public Distribution draft rules specify Level-4 Junior Stenographers with ten years’ regular service as the feeder grade, while MPEDA’s proposal adds a 120 w.p.m. shorthand speed-test requirement for that promotion.

government_service:senior-stenographer-i.label: Career progression
government_service:senior-stenographer-i.text: In the Central Civil Accounts Service, official 2025–2026 circular listings show promotion from Stenographer Grade I at Pay Level 6 to Private Secretary at Level 7, and from Private Secretary at Level 7 to Senior Private Secretary at Level 8.

government_service:senior-stenographer-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-stenographer-i.text: As a dated central-government example, the Department of Food & Public Distribution’s 2024 draft Senior Stenographer rules specify Pay Level 6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400.

government_service:senior-stenographer-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-stenographer-i.text: MPEDA’s 2025 recruitment-rule proposal also places its Senior Stenographer post at Level 6.

government_service:senior-stenographer-i.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-stenographer-i.text: For example, a Jammu & Kashmir Energy Development Agency seniority-list document identifies Senior Stenographer at Pay Level 7, ₹44,900–₹1,42,400.

government_service:senior-technical-assi.label: Pay context
government_service:senior-technical-assi.text: The CEPTAM-11 advertisement lists STA-B at 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400 basic pay, plus allowances and benefits under applicable Government of India rules.

government_service:senior-technical-assi.label: Pay and benefits: dated recruitment context
government_service:senior-technical-assi.text: For the CEPTAM-11 recruitment cycle, STA-B was placed at Pay Matrix Level 6 under the 7th Central Pay Commission: ₹35,400–₹1,12,400 basic pay.

government_service:senior-technical-assi.label: Pay and benefits: dated recruitment context
government_service:senior-technical-assi.text: Treat the quoted pay range as basic-pay matrix context from CEPTAM-11, not as a current net-salary estimate.

government_service:senior-technician-ind.label: Cadre position
government_service:senior-technician-ind.text: The 2016 order places it at Pay Matrix Level 6, above Technician-I (Level 5), Technician-II (Level 4), and Technician-III (Level 2).

government_service:senior-technician-ind.label: Compensation context
government_service:senior-technician-ind.text: As of the cited Railway Board framework, Senior Technician/MCM is mapped to 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6.

government_service:senior-technician-ind.label: Entry route: join a technician cadre, then progress internally
government_service:senior-technician-ind.text: The 2025 RRB technician notification listed Technician Grade-I Signal at Level 5 and Technician Grade III at Level 2; it did not list Senior Technician as a direct-recruitment post.

government_service:senior-technician-ind.label: Progression and mobility
government_service:senior-technician-ind.text: Within the artisan/technician hierarchy in the cited 2016 framework, the relevant sequence is Technician-III (Level 2), Technician-II (Level 4), Technician-I (Level 5), then Senior Technician/MCM (Level 6).

government_service:senior-technician-ind.label: Compensation context: Pay Matrix Level 6, not a single take-home salary
government_service:senior-technician-ind.text: The Railway Board’s RBE 116/2016 cadre-restructuring table maps Senior Technician/MCM to 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6.

government_service:senior-technician-ind.label: Compensation context: Pay Matrix Level 6, not a single take-home salary
government_service:senior-technician-ind.text: Do not treat Level 6 as a promise of one fixed monthly in-hand salary.

government_service:senior-technician-ind.label: Compensation context: Pay Matrix Level 6, not a single take-home salary
government_service:senior-technician-ind.text: Cited cadre level: 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6.

government_service:sepoy-indian-army.label: Compensation context
government_service:sepoy-indian-army.text: Fixed salary figures should be checked against current official pay orders: the Eighth Central Pay Commission was constituted on November 3, 2025, so pay-policy context may change.

government_service:sepoy-indian-army.label: How this regular-service outcome is reached
government_service:sepoy-indian-army.text: A February 2026 regional notice reported a ₹250 CEE fee and an April 1, 2026 application deadline for that particular cycle; those figures are historical, regional/cycle-specific context rather than standing requirements.

government_service:sepoy-indian-army.label: Compensation and benefits context
government_service:sepoy-indian-army.text: Accordingly, a career guide should direct users to current Ministry of Defence, Department of Expenditure and Army notices rather than presenting legacy 7th-CPC figures as a current salary promise.

government_service:station-master-in-ind.label: Pay context
government_service:station-master-in-ind.text: As a dated example, CEN 05/2024 listed Station Master at 7th CPC Pay Level 6 with initial basic pay of ₹35,400.

government_service:station-master-in-ind.label: Progression and development
government_service:station-master-in-ind.text: The Indian Railway Establishment Manual records that Station Superintendent posts in Level 7 are filled by promotion through selection from the Station Master feeder grade.

government_service:station-master-in-ind.label: Progression and development
government_service:station-master-in-ind.text: For example, South Central Railway has published notices for selection to Group B Assistant Operations Manager/Assistant Traffic Manager posts in Level 8.

government_service:station-master-in-ind.label: Compensation context
government_service:station-master-in-ind.text: In the CEN 05/2024 notification, Station Master was listed at 7th CPC Pay Level 6 with an initial basic pay of ₹35,400.

government_service:station-master-in-ind.label: Compensation context
government_service:station-master-in-ind.text: That ₹35,400 figure is dated to the 2024 notification and is basic pay, not a universal monthly in-hand amount.

government_service:station-master-in-ind.label: Compensation context
government_service:station-master-in-ind.text: Dated reference point: CEN 05/2024 listed ₹35,400 as initial basic pay at Pay Level 6.

government_service:stenographer-governme.label: Compensation context
government_service:stenographer-governme.text: As a concrete but dated DRDO example, the CEPTAM-09 Admin & Allied advertisement listed Stenographer Grade-II at 7th CPC Pay Level 4 with a basic-pay range of ₹25,500–81,100.

government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.label: Pay level
government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.text: The post is referenced in current DRDO recruitment rules as Pay Matrix Level 4, ₹25,500–81,100 basic pay.

government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.label: Identified onward progression
government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.text: Under the 2023 rules for Senior Store Assistant, Store Assistant ‘B’ personnel at Level 4 may be considered for promotion after 10 years of regular service in grade and completion of two to four weeks of relevant training.

government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.label: How this grade is normally reached
government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.text: The related Store Assistant ‘A’ cadre is the practical feeder context: the 2023 amendment provides for a five-percent non-selection promotion channel into Store Assistant ‘A’ from eligible Level-1 Group ‘C’ staff with three years’ regular service and Class 12 qualification.

government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.label: Progression beyond Store Assistant ‘B’
government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.text: The clearest rule-based next step identified in the current store-cadre rules is Senior Store Assistant, a Level-6 post.

government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.label: Progression beyond Store Assistant ‘B’
government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.text: The feeder provision expressly includes Store Assistant ‘B’ at Level 4 with 10 years’ regular service in the grade and successful completion of two to four weeks of relevant training from CEPTAM or another recognised training institute.

government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.label: Compensation context
government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.text: As of this review, the cited recruitment rules place Store Assistant ‘B’ at Level 4 in the Central Government pay matrix, whose stated range is ₹25,500–81,100.

government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.label: Compensation context
government_service:store-assistant-b-drd.text: Use ₹25,500 as the Level-4 entry cell in the cited pay matrix, not as a universal net-pay figure.

government_service:store-assistant-drdo.label: Internal promotion provision
government_service:store-assistant-drdo.text: The 2023 amendment to the Store Assistant A/B recruitment rules provides that 5% of Store Assistant A vacancies may be filled by non-selection promotion from eligible Level-1 Group C employees with three years' regular service and a recognized-board Class 12 pass; the rules also refer to qualifying in a departmental examination.

government_service:store-assistant-drdo.label: How to enter through CEPTAM
government_service:store-assistant-drdo.text: Internal route: the 2023 recruitment-rule amendment provides a limited promotion channel into Store Assistant A for qualifying Level-1 Group C employees with the stipulated service and Class 12 qualification.

government_service:store-assistant-drdo.label: Progression and departmental route
government_service:store-assistant-drdo.text: The official 2023 amendment confirms a departmental-examination-linked promotion provision into Store Assistant A: 5% of vacancies may be filled through non-selection promotion from qualifying Level-1 Group C employees who have completed three years of regular service and hold a Class 12 pass.

government_service:store-assistant-drdo.label: Compensation context
government_service:store-assistant-drdo.text: In CEPTAM-10/Admin & Allied recruitment (2022), Store Assistant A was listed at 7th CPC Pay Level 2: ₹19,900–₹63,200 in the pay matrix, with other benefits and allowances under then-applicable Government of India rules.

government_service:sub-inspector-in-cent.label: Post status
government_service:sub-inspector-in-cent.text: The SSC CGL 2025 notice lists Sub Inspector, Central Bureau of Investigation as a Group B post in Pay Level 7.

government_service:sub-inspector-in-cent.label: Primary entry route: SSC CGL
government_service:sub-inspector-in-cent.text: In the SSC CGL 2025 notice, CBI Sub-Inspector appears under Pay Level 7 with a 20–30 age limit and falls under the general bachelor’s-degree qualification applicable to “all other posts.” These are notification-specific conditions, not permanent guarantees for later cycles.

government_service:sub-inspector-in-cent.label: Pay context
government_service:sub-inspector-in-cent.text: The SSC CGL 2025 notice placed CBI Sub-Inspector in Pay Level 7 and showed the Level 7 pay-matrix range as ₹44,900–₹1,42,400.

government_service:sub-inspector-in-cent.label: Pay context
government_service:sub-inspector-in-cent.text: Dated basic-pay context from SSC CGL 2025: Pay Level 7, ₹44,900–₹1,42,400.

government_service:sub-inspector-in-stat.label: Pay context
government_service:sub-inspector-in-stat.text: As a dated example only, Goa Staff Selection Commission’s 2025 Police SI advertisement listed Pay Level 6; candidates should rely on the pay level and allowances stated in the applicable vacancy notice.

government_service:sub-inspector-in-stat.label: Compensation context
government_service:sub-inspector-in-stat.text: As a concrete but non-transferable example, Goa Staff Selection Commission’s Advertisement No. 1 of 2025 listed Police Sub-Inspector at Level 6.

government_service:tax-assistant-in-cbdt.label: Pay-level context
government_service:tax-assistant-in-cbdt.text: The May 2026 SSC CGL notice places Tax Assistant (CBDT) at Pay Level 4, with the published basic-pay range of ₹25,500–₹81,100.

government_service:tax-assistant-in-cbdt.label: Compensation context
government_service:tax-assistant-in-cbdt.text: As of the SSC CGL notice uploaded on May 21, 2026, Tax Assistant in CBDT is shown at Pay Level 4: ₹25,500–₹81,100 in the published pay matrix.

government_service:tax-assistant-in-cbdt.label: Compensation context
government_service:tax-assistant-in-cbdt.text: Actual monthly receipts can differ from the Level 4 basic figure because government pay is processed under applicable pay, allowance, tax, deduction, posting, and service rules.

government_service:technical-officer-a-d.label: Pay-level context
government_service:technical-officer-a-d.text: The Gazette-notified 2024 DRTC schedule places TO-A at 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 7, with a stated range of ₹44,900–₹1,42,400.

government_service:technical-officer-a-d.label: Next grade
government_service:technical-officer-a-d.text: The normal next DRTC Category-B grade is Technical Officer ‘B’ (TO-B), a Group ‘A’, Gazetted, Non-Ministerial Level 10 post.

government_service:technical-officer-a-d.label: Career progression
government_service:technical-officer-a-d.text: The Category-B DRTC sequence shown in the current rules is STA-B (Level 6) → TO-A (Level 7) → TO-B (Level 10) → TO-C (Level 11) → TO-D (Level 12).

government_service:technical-officer-a-d.label: Career progression
government_service:technical-officer-a-d.text: TO-B is a Group ‘A’, Gazetted, Non-Ministerial Level 10 grade.

government_service:technical-officer-a-d.label: Compensation context
government_service:technical-officer-a-d.text: As notified in the 2024 DRTC Recruitment Rules, TO-A is in Pay Matrix Level 7, ₹44,900–₹1,42,400.

government_service:technical-officer-a-d.label: Compensation context
government_service:technical-officer-a-d.text: For comparison within the same route, STA-B is listed at Level 6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400, while TO-B is listed at Level 10, ₹56,100–₹1,77,500.

government_service:technical-officer-a-d.label: Compensation context
government_service:technical-officer-a-d.text: TO-A: Level 7, ₹44,900–₹1,42,400 in the 2024 notified schedule.

government_service:technician-b-drdo.label: Cadre position
government_service:technician-b-drdo.text: Technician ‘B’ is a Category-A Defence Research Technical Cadre post at Pay Level 4, classified as Group ‘C’, Non-Gazetted and Non-Ministerial under the 2024 DRDO Technical Cadre Recruitment Rules.

government_service:technician-b-drdo.label: Pay-matrix context
government_service:technician-b-drdo.text: The 2024 rules list Technician ‘B’ at Level 4, ₹25,500–₹81,100 in the pay matrix.

government_service:technician-b-drdo.label: Pay context
government_service:technician-b-drdo.text: As set out in the Ministry of Defence’s 2024 DRDO Technical Cadre Recruitment Rules, Technician ‘B’ carries Pay Level 4 in the central pay matrix, ₹25,500–₹81,100.

government_service:technician-b-drdo.label: Pay context
government_service:technician-b-drdo.text: Actual monthly gross and take-home pay may differ by pay-cell placement, dearness allowance, house-rent or government-accommodation status, transport and other admissible allowances, deductions, location, and later revisions to central-government compensation rules. source_urls Pay Level: 4.

government_service:technician-b-drdo.label: Pay context
government_service:technician-b-drdo.text: Published basic-pay matrix range in the 2024 rules: ₹25,500–₹81,100.

government_service:technician-drdo.label: Pay context
government_service:technician-drdo.text: For the CEPTAM-11 cycle, Technician-A carried 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 2: ₹19,900–₹63,200 basic pay, with allowances and benefits governed by then-extant Government of India rules.

government_service:technician-drdo.label: Compensation and application-cost context
government_service:technician-drdo.text: As published for CEPTAM-11, Technician-A was in Pay Matrix Level 2, ₹19,900–₹63,200 basic pay under the 7th Central Pay Commission.

government_service:technician-drdo.label: Compensation and application-cost context
government_service:technician-drdo.text: For the CEPTAM-11 application cycle, General/OBC/EWS/MSP Technician-A applicants paid ₹600 upfront: ₹100 non-refundable application fee plus ₹500 refundable fee, while women, SC, ST, PwBD and eligible ex-servicemen paid ₹500 refundable fee.

government_service:technician-drdo.label: Compensation and application-cost context
government_service:technician-drdo.text: The ₹500 refundable component was payable back only to candidates who appeared in Tier-I.

government_service:technician-indian-rai.label: Recruiting designation and level
government_service:technician-indian-rai.text: The principal open-market entry designation is Technician Grade III, ordinarily in Pay Level 2 of the 7th CPC pay matrix; the 2025 RRB Technician notification listed an initial basic pay of ₹19,900 for this level.

government_service:technician-indian-rai.label: Compensation context
government_service:technician-indian-rai.text: As a dated reference point, CEN 02/2025 listed Technician Grade III at 7th CPC Pay Level 2 with initial basic pay of ₹19,900.

government_service:trains-clerk-in-india.label: Pay context
government_service:trains-clerk-in-india.text: CEN 07/2025 listed Trains Clerk at Level 2 of the 7th CPC pay matrix with initial basic pay of ₹19,900.

government_service:trains-clerk-in-india.label: How to enter through RRB NTPC
government_service:trains-clerk-in-india.text: The 2025 CEN required online application and treated the post as a Level-2 undergraduate post; its eligibility date, age limits, vacancies, reservations, application dates and relaxations applied only to that recruitment cycle.

government_service:trains-clerk-in-india.label: Compensation context
government_service:trains-clerk-in-india.text: For the CEN 07/2025 recruitment cycle, Trains Clerk was advertised in 7th CPC Pay Level 2 with an initial basic pay of ₹19,900.

government_service:trains-clerk-in-india.label: Compensation context
government_service:trains-clerk-in-india.text: Dated notice context: Pay Level 2, initial basic pay ₹19,900 in CEN 07/2025.

government_service:upper-division-clerk-.label: Common promotion route
government_service:upper-division-clerk-.text: For example, Puducherry’s 2023 LDCE notice required eligible Level-2 LDCs to have four years’ regular service and pass specified departmental tests; another central recruitment rule provides promotion from Level-2 LDC after five years’ regular service on seniority-cum-fitness.

government_service:upper-division-clerk-.label: Typical pay-matrix context
government_service:upper-division-clerk-.text: Many central-government UDC posts are placed at 7th CPC Pay Level 4 (₹25,500–81,100 basic-pay matrix), although the applicable level and total take-home remuneration must be checked in the employer’s current rules or vacancy notice.

government_service:upper-division-clerk-.label: Entry routes
government_service:upper-division-clerk-.text: For example, the Government of Puducherry’s 9 May 2023 LDCE notice proposed filling UDC vacancies from eligible Level-2 LDCs who had completed at least four years of regular service and passed its Accounts Test and Common General Departmental Tests for Ministerial Staff.

government_service:upper-division-clerk-.label: Entry routes
government_service:upper-division-clerk-.text: A 2025 central recruitment rule instead specifies promotion from Level-2 LDCs with five years’ regular service, according to seniority-cum-fitness, with direct recruitment only if promotion is not possible.

government_service:upper-division-clerk-.label: Progression
government_service:upper-division-clerk-.text: The Office of the Development Commissioner (MSME) has issued orders for promotion from UDC, Group ‘C’, Level 4 to Office Superintendent, Group ‘B’, non-gazetted, Level 6.

government_service:upper-division-clerk-.label: Progression
government_service:upper-division-clerk-.text: ISRO separately states that its UDCs can progress to Assistant in Level 7, subject to vacancy availability and satisfactory performance.

government_service:upper-division-clerk-.label: Compensation context
government_service:upper-division-clerk-.text: As of the sources reviewed, a common central-government UDC benchmark is 7th CPC Pay Level 4, with a basic-pay matrix range of ₹25,500–81,100.

government_service:upper-division-clerk-.label: Compensation context
government_service:upper-division-clerk-.text: The 2024 Ministry of Home Affairs recruitment rules and the Variable Energy Cyclotron Centre’s published designation/pay-level list both show UDC at Level 4 with that range.

government_service:upper-division-clerk-.label: Compensation context
government_service:upper-division-clerk-.text: Common central benchmark: Pay Level 4, ₹25,500–81,100 basic-pay matrix.

government_service:upper-primary-teacher.label: Pay context
government_service:upper-primary-teacher.text: The KVS–NVS Recruitment 2025 notification listed TGT posts at Pay Matrix Level 7, ₹44,900–₹1,42,400.

government_service:upper-primary-teacher.label: Compensation and service-benefit context
government_service:upper-primary-teacher.text: For dated pay context, the KVS–NVS Recruitment 2025 notification placed the listed regular TGT posts in Pay Matrix Level 7, ₹44,900–₹1,42,400.

government_service:upper-primary-teacher.label: Compensation and service-benefit context
government_service:upper-primary-teacher.text: Eligibility and application of any benefit depend on the applicable appointment and service rules. 2025 regular-TGT basic-pay context: Pay Matrix Level 7, ₹44,900–₹1,42,400.

government_service:veterinary-officer-in.label: Compensation context
government_service:veterinary-officer-in.text: As dated examples, Delhi’s 2024 Veterinary Officer recruitment rules specify Pay Level 10 (₹56,100–₹177,500) plus non-practising allowance, while a 2024 West Bengal appointment notification placed Veterinary Officers at state pay level 16, ₹56,100–₹144,300, plus admissible allowances.

government_service:veterinary-officer-in.label: Pay and benefits: notification-specific context
government_service:veterinary-officer-in.text: Delhi’s Veterinary Officer recruitment rules, published in January 2024, list Level 10 in the pay matrix (₹56,100–₹177,500) plus non-practising allowance; this is an example for that employer, not a nationwide entitlement.

government_service:veterinary-officer-in.label: Pay and benefits: notification-specific context
government_service:veterinary-officer-in.text: A separate West Bengal appointment notification dated February 19, 2024 states pay level 16 with a ₹56,100–₹144,300 matrix for Veterinary Officers, plus allowances admissible under then-existing state rules.

government_service:vocational-instructor.label: Progression and mobility
government_service:vocational-instructor.text: For example, Himachal Pradesh publishes ITI Group Instructor seniority material at pay-matrix level 12, while DGT has issued promotion orders to Training Officer posts.

government_service:vocational-instructor.label: Compensation context
government_service:vocational-instructor.text: As dated official examples, Ladakh’s ITI-sector cadre document lists Vocational Instructor at Level 4 (₹25,500–81,100) and Level 6E (₹35,900–113,500) under its specified conditions, whereas an NSTI Ludhiana staff profile identifies a Vocational Instructor at Pay Level 6.

government_service:workshop-superintende.label: Illustrative current pay context
government_service:workshop-superintende.text: As a dated example, the Ladakh Technical Education & Skill Development Department’s 2025 recruitment rules list Workshop Superintendent at Pay Matrix Level 11 (₹67,700–₹2,08,700), but that rule concerns the Polytechnic Sector and should not be treated as an ITI-wide salary guarantee.

government_service:workshop-superintende.label: Entry routes: follow the recruiting State/UT’s notified rules
government_service:workshop-superintende.text: A concrete promotion-led example is Ladakh’s 2025 rule for its Technical Education & Skill Development Department (Polytechnic Sector): it provides 100% promotion, failing which deputation/short-term contract, from specified Lecturer-I engineering posts in Level 8A with a BE/BTech and eight years of regular service.

government_service:workshop-superintende.label: Compensation context: verify the live cadre notification
government_service:workshop-superintende.text: As a dated benchmark only, Ladakh’s 2025 Workshop Superintendent recruitment rules in the Polytechnic Sector specify Level 11 of the pay matrix, ₹67,700–₹2,08,700.

government_service:workshop-superintende.label: Compensation context: verify the live cadre notification
government_service:workshop-superintende.text: By contrast, Central Institute of Technology Kokrajhar’s published rules place its Workshop Superintendent at Level 10, with possible movement to Level 11 after five years subject to the stated assessment.

job_role:accountant.label: Compensation context
job_role:accountant.text: As a dated reference only, the NCS Accountant card—last updated on 16 October 2023—lists ₹8,000–₹12,000 per month for new entrants and ₹20,000–₹35,000 per month for experienced candidates, and explicitly says these figures are indicative and subject to change.

job_role:accountant.label: Compensation context
job_role:accountant.text: Those figures are not a current 2026 salary benchmark and should not be used as an offer expectation.

job_role:accounts-executive.label: Skill-standard context
job_role:accounts-executive.text: NSDC lists the Accounts Executive (Accounts Payable & Receivable) qualification pack BSC/Q0901 at NSQF Level 4, while marking the occupational standard as retired; it is therefore useful as a role-reference rather than proof of a currently active certification requirement.

job_role:accounts-executive.label: Compensation context
job_role:accounts-executive.text: NCS’s Accounts Executive (Accounts Payable & Receivables) profile, last updated on October 16, 2023, gave an indicative range of ₹15,000–₹29,000 per month for candidates with zero to four years of experience.

job_role:accounts-executive.label: Compensation context
job_role:accounts-executive.text: This is historical occupational guidance, not a current salary quote for July 2026.

job_role:accounts-executive.label: Compensation context
job_role:accounts-executive.text: Historical NCS reference point only: ₹15,000–₹29,000 per month for 0–4 years’ experience in the payables/receivables profile.

job_role:after-sales-service-manager.label: Compensation context
job_role:after-sales-service-manager.text: As a dated reference point only, the NCS page for the closely related Area Service Manager role—last updated September 18, 2023—reported indicative monthly earnings of ₹15,000–₹25,000 for new entrants and ₹25,000–₹60,000 for experienced candidates, while explicitly stating that the figures are subject to change.

job_role:after-sales-service-manager.label: Compensation context
job_role:after-sales-service-manager.text: These figures should not be treated as a current market quote or a guaranteed salary for an After-Sales Service Manager in July 2026.

job_role:after-sales-service-manager.label: Compensation context
job_role:after-sales-service-manager.text: Use the NCS 2023 figures only as historical context for a related automotive role, not as a current salary benchmark.

job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.label: Pay and exit package context
job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.text: The Intake 02/2027 notice lists a customised monthly package beginning at ₹30,000 in year 1 and rising to ₹40,000 in year 4, with 30% contributions to the Agniveer Corpus Fund and matching Government contributions.

job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.label: Pay and exit package context
job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.text: It states an approximately ₹10.04 lakh Seva Nidhi corpus at exit before applicable interest; package, allowances and interest are notification- and rule-dependent.

job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.label: Benefits and limitations
job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.text: During engagement, the cited notice provides for service-hospital medical facilities, CSD provisions, applicable allowances and a non-contributory ₹48 lakh life-insurance cover.

job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.label: Compensation and benefits context
job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.text: For Intake 02/2027, the customised monthly package was listed as ₹30,000, ₹33,000, ₹36,500 and ₹40,000 for years 1 through 4 respectively.

job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.label: Compensation and benefits context
job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.text: The same notice estimates a ₹10.04 lakh Seva Nidhi package after four years before interest, based on the stated corpus contributions.

job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.label: Compensation and benefits context
job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.text: Applicants should treat figures as dated context: future notifications, interest rates, tax rules and allowance eligibility may differ. 2026 Intake 02/2027 starting monthly package: ₹30,000, with a stated annual increment. 2026 Intake 02/2027 exit corpus: approximately ₹10.04 lakh before applicable interest after four years.

job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.label: Compensation and benefits context
job_role:agniveer-indian-air-force.text: Non-contributory life-insurance cover stated in the notice: ₹48 lakh during engagement.

job_role:agniveer-indian-army.label: Compensation context
job_role:agniveer-indian-army.text: The original Agnipath package published in June 2022 ranged from ₹30,000 per month in year 1 to ₹40,000 in year 4, with 30% contributed to the Agniveer Corpus Fund and a matching government contribution.

job_role:agniveer-indian-army.label: Compensation context
job_role:agniveer-indian-army.text: The published exit Seva Nidhi figure was approximately ₹11.71 lakh including applicable interest; package, allowances and rules should be verified against the applicable recruitment notification.

job_role:agniveer-indian-army.label: Compensation and benefits context
job_role:agniveer-indian-army.text: In its June 2022 scheme announcement, the Government published a customised monthly package of ₹30,000, ₹33,000, ₹36,500 and ₹40,000 for years 1–4 respectively.

job_role:agniveer-indian-army.label: Compensation and benefits context
job_role:agniveer-indian-army.text: It showed 70% as in-hand pay and 30% as the Agniveer’s monthly contribution to the corpus, matched by the Government; risk and hardship allowances were stated to apply where applicable. source_urls The same 2022 announcement stated that, on completing four years, the Seva Nidhi package would be approximately ₹11.71 lakh including applicable interest.

job_role:agniveer-indian-army.label: Compensation and benefits context
job_role:agniveer-indian-army.text: It also stated that Agniveers would receive non-contributory life insurance cover of ₹48 lakh for the engagement period.

job_role:agniveer-indian-navy.label: Pay and exit-benefit context
job_role:agniveer-indian-navy.text: In the Indian Navy’s 2025 SSR advertisement, the customised monthly package was listed as ₹30,000 in year 1, ₹33,000 in year 2, ₹36,500 in year 3 and ₹40,000 in year 4.

job_role:agniveer-indian-navy.label: Pay and exit-benefit context
job_role:agniveer-indian-navy.text: The same 2025 notice showed total personal and Government corpus contributions of ₹5.02 lakh each over the engagement.

job_role:agniveer-indian-navy.label: Pay and exit-benefit context
job_role:agniveer-indian-navy.text: At completion, the scheme provides a one-time Seva Nidhi package made up of the member’s corpus contribution and matching Government contribution; a 2022 Government release described the indicative exit package as approximately ₹11.71 lakh.

job_role:agniveer-indian-navy.label: Pay and exit-benefit context
job_role:agniveer-indian-navy.text: The notice also states that Agniveers are not covered by Naval Pension Regulations and are not entitled to gratuity for the engagement period. 2025 SSR published package: ₹30,000 to ₹40,000 monthly across years 1–4; figures are dated and notification-specific.

job_role:apparel-quality-assurance-execu.label: Entry routes from the listed education pathways
job_role:apparel-quality-assurance-execu.text: The related AMH/Q1401 qualification pack is not an entry-level school-leaver standard: it lists pathways of Class 12 plus four years’ relevant experience, graduate plus two years’ relevant experience, or an NSQF Level 4 Inline and Measurement Checker certificate plus two years’ experience.

job_role:apparel-sourcing-executive.label: Compensation context
job_role:apparel-sourcing-executive.text: As a dated example observed during this review, one remote India job advertisement for an experienced Apparel Sourcing Executive stated ₹30,000–₹40,000 per month and preferred 3+ years of sourcing, merchandising, or factory-management experience.

job_role:architectural-assistant.label: Compensation context
job_role:architectural-assistant.text: A dated public-sector reference—not a national salary benchmark—is Arunachal Pradesh’s 2021 recruitment rule for Architectural Assistant, which specified Pay Matrix Level 6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400 per month, for that particular state-government post.

job_role:architectural-assistant.label: Compensation context
job_role:architectural-assistant.text: Dated government-post example: Arunachal Pradesh Pay Matrix Level 6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400 per month under its 2021 Architectural Assistant recruitment rule.

job_role:art-director.label: Recognised skills-qualification example
job_role:art-director.text: The Media & Entertainment Skills Council lists the specialised qualification “Art Director (Animation & Gaming)” (MES/Q0501), version 2.0, at NSQF Level 6, with a listed duration of 840 hours.

job_role:art-director.label: Entry routes in India
job_role:art-director.text: MESC’s current listed qualification pack for Art Director (Animation & Gaming), MES/Q0501 version 2.0, is an NSQF Level 6, 840-hour specialised programme.

job_role:assistant-professor.label: Public-sector pay reference
job_role:assistant-professor.text: As dated context, a December 2024 Government of NCT of Delhi SCERT notice described Assistant Professor posts at UGC Academic Level 10 in the ₹57,700–₹1,82,400 pay matrix; allowances and applicability vary by employer and rules.

job_role:assistant-professor.label: Entry routes and eligibility
job_role:assistant-professor.text: The UGC’s 2023 amendment specifies NET/SET/SLET as the minimum criterion for direct recruitment to Assistant Professor; its regulations also provide for a master’s-level 55% threshold, subject to stated relaxations and applicable provisions.

job_role:assistant-professor.label: Career progression
job_role:assistant-professor.text: Within the UGC Career Advancement Scheme framework for college teachers, entry-level Assistant Professor is Academic Level 10.

job_role:assistant-professor.label: Career progression
job_role:assistant-professor.text: Progression to Assistant Professor (Senior Scale), Academic Level 11, is linked to service length and qualifications: four years with a Ph.D., five years with an M.Phil. or specified professional postgraduate degree, or six years otherwise, along with the stated professional-development and assessment requirements.

job_role:assistant-professor.label: Career progression
job_role:assistant-professor.text: The next specified internal step is from Academic Level 11 to Assistant Professor (Selection Grade), Academic Level 12.

job_role:assistant-professor.label: Career progression
job_role:assistant-professor.text: UGC materials state an eligibility condition of five years of service at Level 11, together with the framework’s other requirements.

job_role:assistant-professor.label: Career progression
job_role:assistant-professor.text: Assistant Professor (Senior Scale) — Academic Level 11, subject to CAS eligibility and assessment.

job_role:assistant-professor.label: Career progression
job_role:assistant-professor.text: Assistant Professor (Selection Grade) — Academic Level 12, subject to CAS eligibility and assessment.

job_role:assistant-professor.label: Compensation context
job_role:assistant-professor.text: As a dated public-sector reference, a Government of NCT of Delhi SCERT recruitment notice published on December 17, 2024 identified Assistant Professor posts at UGC Academic Level 10 and a pay-matrix range of ₹57,700–₹1,82,400.

job_role:audit-assistant.label: Pay context, not a benchmark
job_role:audit-assistant.text: As a dated posting-level illustration retrieved in July 2026, one remote Audit Assistant listing advertised ₹20,000–₹30,000 per month, while a separate Internal Audit Assistant listing advertised ₹3.5–₹4.8 lakh per year; these are individual advertisements, not an India-wide salary estimate.

job_role:audit-assistant.label: Compensation context
job_role:audit-assistant.text: As dated vacancy examples available in July 2026, one remote Audit Assistant advertisement showed ₹20,000–₹30,000 per month, and an Internal Audit Assistant advertisement showed ₹3.5–₹4.8 lakh per year.

job_role:bakery-chef.label: Occupational-standard reference
job_role:bakery-chef.text: NSDC lists the Craft Baker qualification pack (FIC/Q5002) at NSQF Level 4, but labels it a retired occupational standard; it is useful as a work-profile reference rather than proof of a currently active certification route.

job_role:biomedical-engineer.label: Compensation context
job_role:biomedical-engineer.text: The National Career Service career page—last updated December 30, 2023—gave an indicative range of ₹25,000–₹29,000 per month for candidates with three to five years’ experience, while expressly stating that the figure was subject to change.

job_role:business-development-executive.label: Compensation context
job_role:business-development-executive.text: As a dated market indicator rather than a guaranteed offer, Indeed India’s guide updated on June 16, 2026 reported an average of ₹20,306 per month for Business Development Executives, while cautioning that pay varies by skills, experience, qualifications and location.

job_role:cake-decorator.label: Related national skills standard
job_role:cake-decorator.text: NSDC lists the related Craft Baker occupational standard at NSQF Level 4; the legacy listing records 280 total hours, including 150 practical hours, but labels the standard as retired, so applicants should verify currently available training or certification options.

job_role:cake-decorator.label: Entry routes in India
job_role:cake-decorator.text: NSDC publishes a related Craft Baker standard at NSQF Level 4, although its page identifies that occupational standard as retired; prospective learners should therefore confirm whether a provider is currently authorised, what credential is issued, and whether the curriculum includes hands-on cake-finishing practice.

job_role:central-sterile-supply-departme.label: Compensation context
job_role:central-sterile-supply-departme.text: As dated examples only, a Tata Memorial Centre 2022 walk-in advertisement listed ₹16,042 per month for Technician (CSSD), while a Tata Memorial Centre deployment advertisement dated March 2024 listed ₹18,500 per month for one Technician (CSSD) post.

job_role:clinical-research-associate.label: Illustrative pay context
job_role:clinical-research-associate.text: As a dated example, Tata Memorial Centre advertised starting remuneration of ₹48,000 or ₹52,000 per month for specified six-month CRA contract posts on 11 April 2026; this is not an India-wide salary benchmark.

job_role:clinical-research-associate.label: Compensation context
job_role:clinical-research-associate.text: As a concrete, dated reference, Tata Memorial Centre advertised six-month CRA posts on 11 April 2026 with starting remuneration of ₹48,000 per month for one specified qualification-and-experience band and ₹52,000 per month for other specified bands.

job_role:commis-chef.label: National occupational standard
job_role:commis-chef.text: Commis Chef is mapped to Tourism & Hospitality Skill Council qualification pack THC/Q0406, version 2.0, at NSQF Level 4.

job_role:commis-chef.label: Published entry benchmark
job_role:commis-chef.text: The accessible THC/Q0406 version 2.0 lists 12th class or a two-year ITI after class 10; alternatively, a one-year ITI after class 10 plus one year of food-production experience, or an NSQF Level 3 Assistant Chef certificate.

job_role:commis-chef.label: Progression context
job_role:commis-chef.text: As an indicative skills-framework reference, the THSC Demi Chef de Partie qualification pack at NSQF Level 5 lists either a three-year diploma plus three years’ Commis Chef experience, or an NSQF Level 4 Commis Chef certificate plus two years’ Commis Chef experience.

job_role:community-development-officer.label: Compensation context
job_role:community-development-officer.text: As a dated example rather than a market benchmark, a 2026 Himachal Pradesh project notice listed maximum emoluments of ₹45,599 for Community Development Officer and Assistant Community Development Officer positions.

job_role:community-development-officer.label: Compensation context
job_role:community-development-officer.text: In a 2026 Himachal Pradesh project expression of interest, the listed maximum emoluments for Community Development Officer and Assistant Community Development Officer were ₹45,599; the same notice described the engagement as requirement-based and not a claim to regular employment.

job_role:content-writer.label: Compensation context
job_role:content-writer.text: As dated examples rather than market benchmarks, NCS listed ₹12,500–₹15,000 per month for freshers and ₹25,000–₹30,000 per month for up to two years' experience, while a March 2026 NeGD contractual post for 3–5 years' experience listed an ₹8 lakh-per-annum budget.

job_role:content-writer.label: Compensation context
job_role:content-writer.text: For dated context, the NCS profile displayed indicative monthly earnings of ₹12,500–₹15,000 for freshers and ₹25,000–₹30,000 for candidates with up to two years' experience; the profile itself says these figures are subject to change.

job_role:content-writer.label: Compensation context
job_role:content-writer.text: Separately, NeGD's March 25, 2026 advertisement listed an ₹8 lakh-per-annum budget for one contractual Content Writer cum Social Media position requiring 3–5 years' experience.

job_role:copywriter.label: Indicative historic pay context
job_role:copywriter.text: NCS’s Advertisement Writer page, last updated August 23, 2016, listed indicative monthly earnings of ₹12,500–₹15,000 for freshers and ₹25,000–₹30,000 for candidates with up to two years’ experience;

job_role:copywriter.label: Indicative historic pay context
job_role:copywriter.text: NCS explicitly states these figures are subject to change, so they should not be treated as a 2026 salary benchmark.

job_role:copywriter.label: Compensation context
job_role:copywriter.text: The only directly cited national career-page pay figures located for this node are NCS’s indicative monthly ranges of ₹12,500–₹15,000 for freshers and ₹25,000–₹30,000 for candidates with up to two years’ experience.

job_role:corporate-security-officer.label: Relevant Indian occupational standard
job_role:corporate-security-officer.text: NSDC lists the Security Officer qualification pack MEP/Q7202 under Security Management at NSQF Level 6; the page was validated on June 4, 2018.

job_role:corporate-social-responsibility.label: Indian regulatory context
job_role:corporate-social-responsibility.text: MCA’s FAQ lists thresholds of net worth of ₹500 crore, turnover of ₹1,000 crore, or net profit of ₹5 crore in the immediately preceding financial year.

job_role:cost-accounting-trainee.label: Stipend context, not a universal salary benchmark
job_role:cost-accounting-trainee.text: In that published structure, a trainee pursuing CMA Intermediate at a corporate or organisation other than a practising cost accountant/firm is listed at ₹20,000, ₹18,000 or ₹15,000 per month in the first year for Category X, Y or Z cities/towns respectively; the listed second-year figures are ₹22,000, ₹20,000 and ₹18,000, and third-year figures are ₹25,000, ₹22,000 and ₹20,000.

job_role:cost-accounting-trainee.label: Stipend context, not a universal salary benchmark
job_role:cost-accounting-trainee.text: For training with a practising cost accountant or cost-accounting firm, the published recommended amounts are ₹2,000, ₹3,000 and ₹4,000 per month for years one, two and three.

job_role:cost-accounting-trainee.label: Stipend context, not a universal salary benchmark
job_role:cost-accounting-trainee.text: ICMAI’s scheme also provides one paid leave day per month and up to 60 days’ unpaid examination leave over the training span, subject to its conditions.

job_role:creative-director-for-a-fashion.label: Compensation context
job_role:creative-director-for-a-fashion.text: As a dated illustration only, an India-based remote luxury-clothing creative-director listing crawled in June 2026 advertised ₹50,000–₹70,000 per month and requested 5–7 years of relevant experience; this is a job advertisement, not a market salary benchmark.

job_role:dairy-production-engineer.label: Compensation context
job_role:dairy-production-engineer.text: As a dated campus-placement reference only, NDRI reports that its undergraduate placements in 2019–20 had an average salary of about ₹5.04 lakh and a maximum of about ₹7.18 lakh; those figures cover NDRI undergraduate placements generally, not this job title specifically, and should not be treated as a current market salary benchmark.

job_role:dairy-production-engineer.label: Compensation context
job_role:dairy-production-engineer.text: For a separate public-sector reference, the 2024 Gazette recruitment rules for Senior Technical Assistant (Dairy) list Pay Level 7, ₹44,900–₹1,42,400, and require B.Tech.

job_role:data-scientist.label: Salary context, not a benchmark
job_role:data-scientist.text: A private salary-aggregation page updated on 2025-08-07 reported an India-wide annual range of ₹4 lakh–₹29.5 lakh for Data Scientists with roughly 1–8 years’ experience.

job_role:data-scientist.label: Salary context, not a benchmark
job_role:data-scientist.text: This is historical, self-reported market context—not an official pay scale or a 2026 offer expectation.

job_role:data-scientist.label: Compensation context
job_role:data-scientist.text: For dated market context only, AmbitionBox reported on 2025-08-07 that Data Scientist salaries in India ranged from ₹4 lakh to ₹29.5 lakh annually for people with approximately one to eight years of experience, based on its submitted-salary dataset.

job_role:data-scientist.label: Compensation context
job_role:data-scientist.text: This is not a government statistic, does not establish an entry-level salary, and may not represent compensation in July 2026.

job_role:data-scientist.label: Compensation context
job_role:data-scientist.text: The older NCS profile listed ₹20,000–₹25,000 per month for new entrants and ₹25,000–₹35,000 per month for experienced candidates, but it was last updated on 2016-08-09 and explicitly says its figures are indicative and subject to change.

job_role:database-administrator.label: Compensation context
job_role:database-administrator.text: As a dated public-sector illustration rather than a market benchmark, a Ministry of Defence young-professional DBA engagement advertised in December 2023 listed consolidated remuneration of ₹60,000 per month.

job_role:database-administrator.label: Compensation: how to interpret salary information
job_role:database-administrator.text: For example, a December 2023 Ministry of Defence consultancy notice for a Young Professional (Database Administrator) specified ₹60,000 per month consolidated remuneration; it should not be treated as a current private-sector salary benchmark or as applicable to all DBA roles.

job_role:dental-surgeon.label: Compensation context
job_role:dental-surgeon.text: As a dated public-sector example only, a Kerala National Rural Health Mission Dental Surgeon notice published for 2024 listed ₹41,000 per month and required BDS from a recognised university plus Kerala State Dental Council registration.

job_role:design-researcher.label: Compensation context
job_role:design-researcher.text: As a dated example rather than a market benchmark, an AICTE-listed full-time UX Researcher internship in Bengaluru displayed a stipend of INR 15,000–20,000 per month and a six-month duration; its application deadline was July 4, 2026.

job_role:digital-marketing-manager.label: Relevant national skills reference
job_role:digital-marketing-manager.text: An NSDC qualification-pack booklet lists “Digital Marketing Manager” (QP code 2022/ME/MESC/05446) at NSQF Level 6, with 840 total notional hours and the Media & Entertainment Skill Council named as awarding body.

job_role:digital-marketing-manager.label: Compensation evidence should not be treated as a standard rate
job_role:digital-marketing-manager.text: Available public estimates differ materially: Indeed’s India tracker reported ₹3,20,210 annual average base pay from 340 reported salaries on February 21, 2026, while a June 2026 IIM Bangalore Manager–Marketing vacancy stated ₹14.02 lakh per annum as indicative remuneration for that distinct, senior contractual role.

job_role:digital-marketing-manager.label: Common routes from specialist work into management
job_role:digital-marketing-manager.text: Use a recognised training pathway where useful; the NSDC booklet includes a Digital Marketing Manager qualification-pack reference at NSQF Level 6.

job_role:digital-marketing-manager.label: Compensation context in India
job_role:digital-marketing-manager.text: As a dated signal only, Indeed reported an India average base salary of ₹3,20,210 per year from 340 reported salaries, updated February 21, 2026.

job_role:digital-marketing-manager.label: Compensation context in India
job_role:digital-marketing-manager.text: For comparison rather than a market benchmark, IIM Bangalore advertised a Manager–Marketing role in June 2026 with indicative remuneration of ₹14.02 lakh per annum plus benefits; it required a master’s degree and at least 10 years’ post-master’s experience.

job_role:digital-marketing-specialist.label: Relevant national-skills context
job_role:digital-marketing-specialist.text: India’s NSDC qualification-pack booklet lists the related occupation “Digital Sales and Marketing Executive” at NSQF Level 4.5, with 1,200 notional hours.

job_role:digital-marketing-specialist.label: Compensation context
job_role:digital-marketing-specialist.text: As dated vacancy examples rather than a market benchmark, one remote India listing advertised ₹7–10 lakh CTC per year for a full-time role seeking 3–5 years of experience, while another Pune-area listing advertised ₹20,000–₹60,000 per month for a role requiring deep Google Ads and Meta Ads expertise.

job_role:diploma-engineer-trainee-psu.label: Mobility and service commitments
job_role:diploma-engineer-trainee-psu.text: HURL’s 2024 DET notice allowed posting at company units/offices anywhere in India and required a ₹2 lakh service-agreement bond for three years after successful training; these are employer-specific 2024 terms, not universal DET rules.

job_role:diploma-engineer-trainee-psu.label: Pay context
job_role:diploma-engineer-trainee-psu.text: As dated examples, POWERGRID’s 2024 notice stated ₹24,000 basic pay plus IDA, HRA and 12% perks during training, with absorption at Junior Engineer Grade IV/S1 at ₹25,000 basic;

job_role:diploma-engineer-trainee-psu.label: Pay context
job_role:diploma-engineer-trainee-psu.text: MSEDCL’s January 2024 internal notice listed ₹18,000 monthly remuneration for its DET roles.

job_role:diploma-engineer-trainee-psu.label: Compensation and benefits: dated examples, not a universal salary
job_role:diploma-engineer-trainee-psu.text: In POWERGRID’s 2024 notification, Diploma Trainees were placed at S0 with ₹24,000 basic pay plus IDA, HRA and 12% perks during the one-year training period; after successful completion, the notice stated Junior Engineer Grade IV/S1 basic pay of ₹25,000 in the ₹25,000–117,500 IDA scale and approximate annual CTC of ₹11.9 lakh.

job_role:diploma-engineer-trainee-psu.label: Compensation and benefits: dated examples, not a universal salary
job_role:diploma-engineer-trainee-psu.text: As a contrasting dated example, MSEDCL’s January 2024 internal notification specified ₹18,000 monthly remuneration for Diploma Engineer Trainee (Distribution)/(Civil), then stated absorption into Junior Engineer roles under its own pay scale.

job_role:educational-counsellor.label: Compensation context
job_role:educational-counsellor.text: As dated context only, an NCS-listed, now-expired education-sector vacancy for a “Counselling and Career Development Officer” advertised ₹25,000–₹28,000 per month, was posted on July 6, 2024, and listed 0–1 years of experience.

job_role:engineering-manager.label: India compensation context
job_role:engineering-manager.text: Indicative only: Indeed India reported an approximate average Engineering Manager salary of ₹11,36,653 per year in an article updated December 2, 2025.

job_role:engineering-manager.label: Compensation context in India
job_role:engineering-manager.text: As dated market context only, an Indeed India article updated December 2, 2025 cited an approximate average of ₹11,36,653 per year.

job_role:epidemiologist.label: Dated compensation reference
job_role:epidemiologist.text: A June 2026 NCDC-IDSP contractual Consultant Epidemiologist notice stated a consolidated ₹90,000–₹150,000 per month, tied to post-qualification experience.

job_role:epidemiologist.label: Compensation context
job_role:epidemiologist.text: As a dated example, NCDC’s 30 June 2026 IDSP terms of reference advertised five contractual Consultant Epidemiologist posts with a ₹90,000–₹150,000 monthly consolidated-remuneration band: ₹90,000 for up to three years of post-qualification experience, ₹120,000 for more than three to under 10 years, and ₹150,000 for 10 or more years.

job_role:fashion-designer.label: Compensation context
job_role:fashion-designer.text: As a dated, entry-adjacent benchmark only, the National Career Service page for Assistant Fashion Designer—last updated on 16 November 2023—listed ₹20,000 to ₹27,000 per month for candidates with experience and expressly described the figures as indicative and subject to change.

job_role:fashion-merchandiser.label: Occupational-standard reference
job_role:fashion-merchandiser.text: NSDC lists the apparel “Merchandiser” qualification pack AMH/Q0901 at NSQF Level 5, but labels it a retired occupational standard; use it as a role-description reference rather than as evidence of a current mandatory credential.

job_role:food-and-beverage-service-execu.label: Education routes in India
job_role:food-and-beverage-service-execu.text: Entry-level skill training can also support entry: THSC’s Food and Beverage Service Assistant qualification is at NSQF/NCrF Level 3 and lists Grade 10 pass as one entry option for that qualification.

job_role:food-technologist.label: Role-specific skill standard context
job_role:food-technologist.text: FICSI lists “Food Technologist – Plant based proteins” as an NSQF Level 5, 510-hour facilitator-guide role.

job_role:freelance-web-developer.label: Government-backed training option
job_role:freelance-web-developer.text: NIELIT’s Certified Web Developer qualification is NSQF Level 3 and lists a 210-hour curriculum covering HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, PHP, MySQL/database connectivity and a website-development project.

job_role:freelance-web-developer.label: Entry routes in India
job_role:freelance-web-developer.text: Its entry criteria provide a skills-training route: Class 12 with a computer background; alternatively, Class 10 with two years of relevant experience; or a relevant NSQF Level 3 qualification with three years of relevant experience.

job_role:front-office-executive.label: Related occupational standard
job_role:front-office-executive.text: NSDC lists “Front Office Executive” under Front Office Management as qualification pack THC/Q0109 at NSQF Level 5.

job_role:front-office-executive.label: Entry routes in India
job_role:front-office-executive.text: Separately, NSDC lists Front Office Executive (THC/Q0109) at NSQF Level 5; candidates should confirm the current assessment, provider and eligibility details directly with the training provider or awarding body before enrolling.

job_role:front-office-executive.label: Compensation context
job_role:front-office-executive.text: As dated reference context only, NCS’s comparable Receptionist (Hotel) page—last updated December 29, 2023—listed ₹12,500–₹25,000 per month for candidates with experience and explicitly described the figures as indicative and subject to change.

job_role:general-manager-service.label: Career level
