job_role:general-manager-service.text: The Automotive Skills Development Council places Automotive Service Manager at NSQF Level 7 and describes 5–10 years' minimum experience; individual General Manager Service employers may ask for substantially more senior experience.

job_role:general-manager-service.label: Relevant Indian skills framework
job_role:general-manager-service.text: For automotive service as one important Indian pathway, NSDC lists related Service and Spare Parts Business roles including Territory Service Manager (Level 5), Area Service Manager (Level 6), Key Accounts Service Manager (Level 6), and Regional Manager—Customer Care (Level 6).

job_role:general-manager-service.label: Common routes into the role
job_role:general-manager-service.text: In automotive service, ASDC identifies Automotive Service Manager as an NSQF Level 7 role and shows a service career ladder containing technician, adviser, quality, workshop and manager roles.

job_role:general-manager-service.label: Progression from Service Manager
job_role:general-manager-service.text: NSDC's automotive framework shows related territory, area, key-account and regional service/customer-care management roles at Levels 5–6, while ASDC identifies Automotive Service Manager at Level 7; actual title order differs among employers and sectors.

job_role:graduate-engineer-trainee.label: Training pay and conversion
job_role:graduate-engineer-trainee.text: As dated examples, STEAG’s 2025 FAQ stated ₹25,000 per month during its six-month on-job GET phase and ₹5 lakh per annum after successful completion;

job_role:graduate-engineer-trainee.label: Compensation context
job_role:graduate-engineer-trainee.text: As a dated employer example only, STEAG’s 2025 GET FAQ stated ₹25,000 per month during a six-month on-job-training phase, free shared bachelor accommodation at the plant site during that phase, and a ₹5 lakh annual package after successful completion.

job_role:graphic-designer.label: Recognised skills qualification
job_role:graphic-designer.text: The National Qualification Register lists a “Graphic Designer” certificate in the Media & Entertainment sector at NSQF Level 4.

job_role:hospital-sales-representative.label: Formal skill-qualification context
job_role:hospital-sales-representative.text: The National Qualifications Register qualification file maps Medical Sales Representative to NSQF Level 4 and states that the occupation does not have a licensing requirement in that qualification framework.

job_role:hospital-sales-representative.label: Progression pathways
job_role:hospital-sales-representative.text: The National Qualifications Register file identifies Therapeutics Business Manager (NSQF Level 5) as vertical progression from Medical Sales Representative.

job_role:hospital-sales-representative.label: Progression pathways
job_role:hospital-sales-representative.text: The same file gives an illustrative pathway in which, after three to four years of industry work as a Medical Sales Representative following Level 4 certification, a candidate may qualify for Therapeutics Business Manager at Level 5.

job_role:instructional-designer.label: Compensation context
job_role:instructional-designer.text: A historical campus-drive notice, dated August 2023, listed ₹6.85 lakh per annum CTC for an Instructional Designer role in Mumbai.

job_role:instructional-designer.label: Compensation context
job_role:instructional-designer.text: One RK University campus-drive notice for a Zeus Learning Instructional Designer position in Mumbai listed ₹6.85 lakh per annum CTC; the notice is explicitly tied to the 2024 graduating batch, with registration in August 2023.

job_role:interior-designer.label: Compensation context
job_role:interior-designer.text: NCS publishes indicative monthly earnings of ₹29,000–₹30,000 for up to six years’ experience, ₹43,000–₹45,000 for six to ten years, and ₹59,000–₹60,000 for over ten years; its page expressly says these figures are indicative and subject to change.

job_role:junior-engineer-psu.label: Illustrative pay context
job_role:junior-engineer-psu.text: As a dated example, POWERGRID's October 2024 notification placed trainees at ₹24,000 basic pay in the S0 IDA scale during training and stated absorption as Junior Engineer Grade IV at the S1 scale of ₹25,000–₹117,500, with an approximate annual CTC of ₹11.9 lakh.

job_role:junior-engineer-psu.label: Compensation context
job_role:junior-engineer-psu.text: As a dated employer example, POWERGRID's October 2024 notice stated ₹24,000 basic pay during one year of Diploma Trainee training, then Junior Engineer Grade IV absorption in the S1 IDA scale of ₹25,000–₹117,500 and approximate annual CTC of ₹11.9 lakh.

job_role:junior-resident-doctor.label: Dated pay example
job_role:junior-resident-doctor.text: At VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital, the notice dated February 18, 2026 listed Junior Resident monthly basic pay of ₹56,100 and a total of ₹134,572 including NPA, HRA, DA and TA; this is an institutional snapshot, not an India-wide salary benchmark.

job_role:junior-resident-doctor.label: Compensation: use current employer notices
job_role:junior-resident-doctor.text: As a dated public-sector example, VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital’s February 18, 2026 notice reported monthly Junior Resident basic pay of ₹56,100, NPA of ₹11,220, HRA of ₹16,830, DA of ₹39,046 and TA of ₹11,376, for a stated total of ₹134,572.

job_role:junior-resident-doctor.label: Compensation: use current employer notices
job_role:junior-resident-doctor.text: Its May 2025 recruitment notice also described the post as Pay Level 10, ₹56,100 plus NPA and other admissible allowances.

job_role:kitchen-trainee.label: National occupational qualification
job_role:kitchen-trainee.text: Kitchen Trainee is specified by the Tourism & Hospitality Skill Council (THSC) as qualification pack THC/Q2702, version 4.0, at NSQF Level 3 with 13 credits.

job_role:kitchen-trainee.label: Published qualification entry profile
job_role:kitchen-trainee.text: The qualification pack lists Grade 10/equivalent as the standard educational route, with specified experience-based alternatives for Grade 8, Grade 9, or a relevant NSQF Level 2 qualification; it lists a minimum job-entry age of 17 years.

job_role:kitchen-trainee.label: Entry routes in the Indian education and skills system
job_role:kitchen-trainee.text: Its published eligibility profile uses Grade 10/equivalent as the usual entry point, while allowing defined experience-based alternatives for learners with Grade 8, Grade 9 or a relevant Level 2 qualification.

job_role:kitchen-trainee.label: Likely progression after trainee level
job_role:kitchen-trainee.text: THSC places Kitchen Trainee at NSQF Level 3 and Commis at Level 4; the Commis qualification expands responsibility to setting up kitchen operations, preparing food and base items, monitoring stock, and closing the kitchen at shift end.

job_role:kitchen-trainee.label: Likely progression after trainee level
job_role:kitchen-trainee.text: Further THSC role specifications show a higher-responsibility sequence of Demi Chef de Partie at Level 4.5 and Chef de Partie at Level 5.

job_role:kitchen-trainee.label: Likely progression after trainee level
job_role:kitchen-trainee.text: Kitchen Trainee — NSQF Level 3: supervised foundational kitchen operations.

job_role:kitchen-trainee.label: Likely progression after trainee level
job_role:kitchen-trainee.text: Commis — NSQF Level 4: broader preparation and kitchen-operation responsibility.

job_role:kitchen-trainee.label: Likely progression after trainee level
job_role:kitchen-trainee.text: Demi Chef de Partie — NSQF Level 4.5: section-level preparation, quality and guidance of Commis staff.

job_role:kitchen-trainee.label: Likely progression after trainee level
job_role:kitchen-trainee.text: Chef de Partie — NSQF Level 5: designated-section production, inventory and supervisory responsibility.

job_role:lab-technician.label: Healthcare training benchmark
job_role:lab-technician.text: HSSC lists the Medical Laboratory Technician qualification pack HSS/Q0301 at proposed NSQF Level 4, with 2,000 notional training hours, including 1,500 classroom/skill-lab hours and 500 hours of OJT, clinical or laboratory training.

job_role:lab-technician.label: Compensation context
job_role:lab-technician.text: NCS’s life-sciences profile, last updated December 30, 2023, gave an indicative range of ₹16,000–₹18,000 per month for experienced candidates; it explicitly states that the figure is indicative and subject to change, so it should not be treated as a current market benchmark.

job_role:lab-technician.label: Compensation context
job_role:lab-technician.text: As a dated public-sector reference, RRB CEN 04/2024 listed Laboratory Assistant Grade II at 7th CPC Pay Level 3 with initial pay of ₹21,700.

job_role:maintenance-engineer.label: Entry routes in India
job_role:maintenance-engineer.text: DGT lists Mechanic Machine Tool Maintenance as a two-year, NSQF Level 4 CTS trade for candidates who have passed Class 10 with Science and Mathematics or an equivalent vocational subject.

job_role:maintenance-engineer.label: Compensation context
job_role:maintenance-engineer.text: As a dated reference only, the NCS Maintenance Executive profile—last updated on December 26, 2018—listed indicative new-entrant earnings of ₹15,000–₹19,000 per month and expressly stated that the figures were subject to change.

job_role:maintenance-supervisor.label: Pay context, not a current benchmark
job_role:maintenance-supervisor.text: NCS’s plant-and-machinery supervisor profile, last updated April 28, 2024, reported an indicative experienced-candidate range of ₹50,000–₹65,000 per month and explicitly stated that figures are subject to change.

job_role:maintenance-supervisor.label: Pay context, not a current benchmark
job_role:maintenance-supervisor.text: It should not be treated as a 2026 salary promise.

job_role:maintenance-supervisor.label: Compensation context
job_role:maintenance-supervisor.text: The closest NCS profile reported ₹50,000–₹65,000 per month for experienced candidates, but that page was last updated on April 28, 2024 and labels the figures indicative and subject to change; it is useful only as historical context, not as a current market rate.

job_role:maintenance-supervisor.label: Compensation context
job_role:maintenance-supervisor.text: As a contrast showing employer and contract variation, a January 2026 Tata Memorial Centre outsourced Junior Engineer (Mechanical) notice specified a consolidated ₹30,000–₹40,000 per month for a role requiring a mechanical diploma plus five years’ experience and willingness to work shifts.

job_role:marketing-manager.label: Compensation context
job_role:marketing-manager.text: As a dated and sector-specific reference only, NCS’s automotive Marketing Manager – Line of Business profile, last updated 18 September 2023, listed indicative earnings for experienced candidates of ₹25,000–₹41,000 per month and explicitly stated that the figures were subject to change.

job_role:marketing-manager.label: Compensation context
job_role:marketing-manager.text: The Code on Wages, 2019 provides for minimum rates of wages and a Central Government floor wage framework, but it does not prescribe one Marketing Manager salary nationwide.

job_role:medical-officer.label: Pay context
job_role:medical-officer.text: As one dated central-government example, ISRO’s 2026 advertisement placed Medical Officer–SC at Pay Level 10 (₹56,100–₹1,77,500 basic pay) plus admissible allowances and stated Non-Practising Allowance at 20% of basic pay.

job_role:medical-officer.label: Compensation context
job_role:medical-officer.text: As a dated reference point only, ISRO’s 2026 Medical Officer–SC advertisement stated Pay Level 10, with a basic-pay range of ₹56,100–₹1,77,500, admissible allowances, and Non-Practising Allowance at 20% of basic pay.

job_role:monitoring-and-evaluation-offic.label: Compensation context
job_role:monitoring-and-evaluation-offic.text: For dated context, WHO India's 30 June 2023 National Professional Officer (M&E) notice stated an annual base salary starting at INR 2,626,256, subject to applicable mandatory deductions.

job_role:monitoring-and-evaluation-offic.label: Compensation context
job_role:monitoring-and-evaluation-offic.text: A much earlier UNDP India RBSK posting, with a 10-year post-master's experience requirement, listed INR 127,175 per month taxable.

job_role:motion-graphics-designer.label: Compensation context
job_role:motion-graphics-designer.text: As a dated public-sector example, C-DIT’s 2025 notification advertised one Motion Graphics Designer role on a one-year, performance-extendable contract at ₹34,190–₹37,800 per month consolidated, with stated qualification and experience criteria.

job_role:nursery-manager.label: Skills-training context
job_role:nursery-manager.text: As listed by the Agriculture Skill Council of India on July 18, 2026, relevant NSQF-aligned qualifications include Plant Nursery Associate (Level 3), Gardener cum Nursery Raiser (Level 4), and Professional Gardening and Nursery Management (Level 4.5).

job_role:nursing-supervisor.label: Public-sector pay context
job_role:nursing-supervisor.text: In Ladakh's notified rules, Assistant Matron/Sister/Nursing Supervisor is shown at Level 6E, ₹35,900–₹113,200; this is an example of a government pay structure, not an India-wide salary benchmark.

job_role:nursing-supervisor.label: Career progression
job_role:nursing-supervisor.text: At central government research-hospital level, Department of Health Research recruitment rules published for comment showed a Nursing Supervisor post filled 100% by promotion from eligible Staff Nurses with two years of regular Level-7 service, and a Deputy Nursing Superintendent post promoted from eligible Nursing Supervisors with two years of regular Level-8 service.

job_role:nursing-supervisor.label: Compensation context
job_role:nursing-supervisor.text: In the Ladakh Health and Medical (Subordinate) Service rules available in 2025, the combined Assistant Matron/Sister/Nursing Supervisor designation is listed at Level 6E, ₹35,900–₹113,200.

job_role:nursing-supervisor.label: Compensation context
job_role:nursing-supervisor.text: For a dated non-pay-matrix comparison, a Tata Memorial Centre advertisement published in 2022 listed a fixed monthly ₹30,000 for one Nursing Supervisor opening at HBCH&RC Muzaffarpur, alongside specified qualification and experience conditions.

job_role:nursing-tutor.label: Compensation context: employer and state rules matter
job_role:nursing-tutor.text: For dated public-sector context, a Kerala Directorate of Health Services appointment order dated September 7, 2024 appointed Nursing Tutors in the pay scale of ₹50,200–₹105,300.

job_role:nursing-tutor.label: Compensation context: employer and state rules matter
job_role:nursing-tutor.text: A NEIGRIHMS document concerning amended draft recruitment rules dated 2023 proposed Level 10 of the pay matrix for Tutor; it is a draft-rule reference rather than evidence of a universal pay entitlement.

job_role:nursing-tutor.label: Compensation context: employer and state rules matter
job_role:nursing-tutor.text: Example only: Kerala Health Services appointment order dated September 7, 2024 — ₹50,200–₹105,300 for Nursing Tutor appointments covered by that order.

job_role:nursing-tutor.label: Compensation context: employer and state rules matter
job_role:nursing-tutor.text: Example only: NEIGRIHMS 2023 amended draft rules proposed Pay Matrix Level 10 for Tutor.

job_role:operation-theatre-supervisor.label: Public-sector pay context
job_role:operation-theatre-supervisor.text: In GMCH Chandigarh’s 2023 proposed rule, Operation Theatre Supervisor is a Group B, non-ministerial post at 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6 (₹35,400–₹1,12,400); this should not be treated as a national salary benchmark or an in-hand-pay figure.

job_role:operation-theatre-supervisor.label: Compensation context
job_role:operation-theatre-supervisor.text: As a dated public-sector reference only, GMCH Chandigarh’s 2023 proposed recruitment rule places Operation Theatre Supervisor at 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400.

job_role:operation-theatre-technician.label: Skill-qualification route
job_role:operation-theatre-technician.text: The Healthcare Sector Skill Council’s Operating Theatre Technician qualification pack, HSS/Q2601, is mapped at proposed NSQF Level 4 and specifies 1,200 notional training hours, including 400 hours of OJT/clinical/lab training.

job_role:operation-theatre-technician.label: Entry routes in India
job_role:operation-theatre-technician.text: A diploma-led route is available through the Healthcare Sector Skill Council qualification pack for Operating Theatre Technician (HSS/Q2601), which is shown at proposed NSQF Level 4 with classroom/skill-lab and clinical or on-the-job training components.

job_role:operation-theatre-technician.label: Progression and adjacent roles
job_role:operation-theatre-technician.text: The NCAHP curriculum document describes a proposed progression framework with diploma holders beginning at NSQF Level 4 and baccalaureate holders at Level 5; it expressly notes that implementation may vary with the prevailing system and regulations.

job_role:operation-theatre-technician.label: Compensation context
job_role:operation-theatre-technician.text: For example, Safdarjung Hospital’s 2025 recruitment rules placed its Operation Theatre Technician post at Central Pay Matrix Level 4, with the published range of Rs. 25,500–81,100.

job_role:operation-theatre-technician.label: Compensation context
job_role:operation-theatre-technician.text: In contrast, a 2024 CRPF recruitment-rule document placed Assistant Sub-Inspector (Operation Theatre Technician) at Level 5, Rs. 29,200–92,300.

job_role:pastry-chef.label: Role standard context
job_role:pastry-chef.text: NSDC’s curriculum catalogue lists “Pastry Chef” under the Tourism and Hospitality Skill Council at NSQF Level 5 (THC/Q2708).

job_role:pastry-chef.label: Entry routes in India
job_role:pastry-chef.text: A skills-based route is also available: NSDC lists the Pastry/Bakery Commis qualification (THC/Q2708) at NSQF Level 4.

job_role:pastry-chef.label: Entry routes in India
job_role:pastry-chef.text: This can be a practical entry point into junior pastry-kitchen work, while the NSDC catalogue separately lists Pastry Chef at Level 5.

job_role:pastry-chef.label: Career progression
job_role:pastry-chef.text: The NSDC catalogue provides a useful qualification-level signal rather than a guaranteed promotion ladder: it lists Pastry/Bakery Commis at Level 4 and Pastry Chef at Level 5; it also lists Demi Chef de Partie at Level 5, Chef-de-Partie at Level 6, Sous Chef at Level 7 and Executive Chef at Level 8.

job_role:permanent-sailor-indian-navy.label: Compensation and benefits: verify current orders
job_role:permanent-sailor-indian-navy.text: A Navy sailor recruitment notice for an earlier regular entry stated that, after initial training, sailors were placed in Defence Pay Matrix Level 3 with Military Service Pay and dearness allowance, and described medical care, travel concessions, housing-related benefits and other entitlements.

job_role:permanent-sailor-indian-navy.label: Compensation and benefits: verify current orders
job_role:permanent-sailor-indian-navy.text: The same earlier notice stated that promotion to Master Chief Petty Officer-I corresponded to Level 8.

job_role:pharmacist.label: Public-sector pay example
job_role:pharmacist.text: As a dated central-government example, 2025 recruitment rules for one Pharmacist post specified Pay Level 5 (₹29,200–₹92,300), alongside approved pharmacy qualification and State Pharmacy Council registration requirements; this is not a nationwide salary benchmark.

job_role:pharmacist.label: Compensation context
job_role:pharmacist.text: For a dated public-sector reference point only, 2025 central-government rules for a specified Pharmacist post listed Pay Level 5, ₹29,200–₹92,300.

job_role:physiotherapist.label: Entry-level education context
job_role:physiotherapist.text: The National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) physiotherapy handbook maps entry level to NSQF Level 6 after a minimum five-year Bachelor of Physiotherapy programme, including a mandatory foundation course in its recommended curriculum.

job_role:physiotherapist.label: Progression and specialisation
job_role:physiotherapist.text: The NCAHP handbook’s proposed job descriptions move from Level 6 activities such as treatment preparation, recording, equipment familiarity and supervised procedures to Level 7 professional-development and critical-evaluation capability, Level 8 consultation for urgent clinical response, Level 9 teaching and research involvement, and Level 10 protocol, quality-assurance and departmental-upgrade responsibilities.

job_role:plant-maintenance-manager.label: Technical foundation
job_role:plant-maintenance-manager.text: Relevant preparation can begin through DGT’s two-year Mechanic Machine Tool Maintenance CTS trade, which is open after Class 10 with Science and Mathematics (or a vocational subject in the sector) and is classified at NSQF Level 4.

job_role:policy-analyst.label: Illustrative public-sector pay context
job_role:policy-analyst.text: As listed on NITI Aayog’s Work for Viksit Bharat portal when reviewed on July 18, 2026, Young Professional remuneration was ₹70,000 per month;

job_role:policy-analyst.label: Illustrative public-sector pay context
job_role:policy-analyst.text: Consultant Grade 1 was listed at ₹80,000–₹1,45,000 per month.

job_role:policy-analyst.label: Compensation context
job_role:policy-analyst.text: For a dated official reference point rather than a market-wide estimate, NITI Aayog’s Work for Viksit Bharat portal listed monthly remuneration of ₹70,000 for Young Professionals, ₹80,000–₹1,45,000 for Consultant Grade 1, ₹1,45,000–₹2,65,000 for Consultant Grade 2, and ₹2,65,000–₹3,30,000 for Senior Consultants when reviewed on July 18, 2026.

job_role:portfolio-manager.label: Compensation context
job_role:portfolio-manager.text: As dated credential context rather than a portfolio-manager salary benchmark, CFA Institute’s 2026 India impact study reports average annual compensation of ₹22.1 lakh among its combined respondent group of CFA charterholders and candidates, and reports that more than 70% of charterholders with over eight years’ experience typically earn above ₹40 lakh annually.

job_role:pre-primary-school-coordinator.label: Compensation context
job_role:pre-primary-school-coordinator.text: A January 2026 advertisement from a Kota school listed ₹14,000–₹16,000 per month for its particular full-time contractual Pre-primary Coordinator vacancy; this is a dated, employer-specific example and should not be treated as an India-wide salary benchmark.

job_role:primary-school-academic-coordin.label: Pay context
job_role:primary-school-academic-coordin.text: One India-wide school recruitment listing dated May 2026 advertised Primary Coordinator pay of ₹25,000–₹40,000 per month; this is an example vacancy range, not a national salary standard.

job_role:primary-school-academic-coordin.label: Compensation context
job_role:primary-school-academic-coordin.text: As a dated market example only, a May 2026 recruitment listing advertised ₹25,000–₹40,000 per month for a Primary Coordinator; a separate employer-provided Vijayawada listing showed ₹30,000–₹40,000 per month for a Primary Academic Coordinator in an IGCSE setting.

job_role:primary-school-teacher-private.label: Compensation context
job_role:primary-school-teacher-private.text: As a dated employer example rather than a market benchmark, a Vivekananda Kendra Vidyalaya recruitment notice published for its 2026 intake listed initial monthly emoluments of ₹13,000–₹15,000 for Primary Teachers, with placement, qualifications, experience and interview performance affecting the starting amount.

job_role:primary-school-teacher-private.label: Compensation context
job_role:primary-school-teacher-private.text: The National Career Service profile, last updated in December 2018, listed ₹15,000–₹20,000 per month for experienced candidates and clearly labelled the figures indicative and subject to change.

job_role:private-tutor.label: Earnings context
job_role:private-tutor.text: As variable, dated examples, NCS listings posted in July 2026 included a part-time home-tutor opening advertised at ₹36,000–₹72,000 per annum and other home-tutor listings at ₹96,000–₹180,000 or ₹144,000–₹180,000 per annum; individual fees and pay depend on locality, hours, subjects, grade level, experience and the engagement terms.

job_role:private-tutor.label: Compensation and fee context
job_role:private-tutor.text: For dated market context only, NCS education listings visible in July 2026 included a part-time home-tutor advertisement for Class 4 and 8 support at ₹36,000–₹72,000 per annum, alongside other home-tutor advertisements at ₹96,000–₹180,000 and ₹144,000–₹180,000 per annum.

job_role:production-engineer.label: Occupational standard context
job_role:production-engineer.text: The former Capital Goods Skill Council qualification pack CSC/Q1201, titled Production Engineer, was listed at NSQF Level 5.

job_role:production-engineer.label: Compensation context
job_role:production-engineer.text: As historical context only, the NCS Production Engineer profile—last updated on 23 August 2016—reported indicative monthly earnings of ₹10,000–₹25,000 for candidates with up to five years’ experience and ₹25,000–₹80,000 for those with more than five years’ experience, while explicitly stating that the figures were subject to change.

job_role:production-engineer.label: Compensation context
job_role:production-engineer.text: These 2016 figures are not a 2026 market estimate and should not be used to set salary expectations.

job_role:public-health-nurse.label: Compensation context
job_role:public-health-nurse.text: As dated central-government context, the AIIH&PH Public Health Nursing Officer schedule associated with the 2019 recruitment rules lists Level 8 in the pay matrix, with a range of ₹47,600–₹1,51,100; it should not be treated as a current or universal salary promise for PHN vacancies elsewhere.

job_role:public-health-programme-manager.label: Compensation context
job_role:public-health-programme-manager.text: As dated illustrations rather than a current market rate, a National AYUSH Mission Kerala notification dated 10 October 2025 advertised a contractual District Programme Manager at ₹40,000 consolidated per month, while a December 2025 AIIMS Delhi project advertisement listed ₹75,270 consolidated for a Senior Research Scientist eligible with MPH/public-health/health-administration qualifications and ₹128,050 for a Junior Public Health Specialist–Field with relevant public-health experience.

job_role:quality-control-analyst.label: Education and occupational standard
job_role:quality-control-analyst.text: NSDC also lists an “Analyst/Chemist–Quality Control” qualification at NSQF Level 5, including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FT-IR and dissolution testing.

job_role:quality-control-analyst.label: Entry routes in India
job_role:quality-control-analyst.text: It is listed at NSQF Level 5 and covers instrumental methods including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis spectroscopy, FT-IR and dissolution testing.

job_role:quality-control-analyst.label: Compensation context
job_role:quality-control-analyst.text: As a dated reference rather than a current market guarantee, the NCS Quality Control Chemist profile, last updated on December 30, 2023, listed indicative new-entrant earnings of ₹8,500 to ₹55,000 per month and explicitly stated that the figures were subject to change.

job_role:quality-engineer.label: Indian skills-standard reference
job_role:quality-engineer.text: NSDC lists the legacy Quality Engineer qualification pack ELE/Q7901 under Electronics Sector Skills Council of India, Medical Electronics, Quality Maintenance, at NSQF Level 5;

job_role:quality-engineer.label: Entry routes in India
job_role:quality-engineer.text: Class 12 plus two years of experience; an NSQF Level 4 relevant qualification plus three years of experience; or Class 10 plus four years of relevant experience.

job_role:quality-engineer.label: Progression and professional development
job_role:quality-engineer.text: In the ESSCI electronics framework, Quality Manager – Electronics is mapped at NSQF Level 6, above the former Quality Engineer Level 5 reference, and its scope includes quality across product design, supplier receipt inspection, production, final output, and management of inspectors and supervisors.

job_role:radiographer.label: Entry-level education
job_role:radiographer.text: The MoHFW Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology curriculum maps entry after a minimum 2.5-year diploma to NSQF level 4, and entry after a minimum four-year baccalaureate programme to NSQF level 5.

job_role:radiographer.label: Public-sector pay context
job_role:radiographer.text: As a dated government-recruitment example, ESIC lists the Radiographer post at Pay Level 5 (₹29,200–₹92,300 in the pay matrix); applicable pay, allowances, eligibility and vacancies depend on the particular notification.

job_role:radiographer.label: Progression after entry
job_role:radiographer.text: ISRO’s published recruitment and career-prospects page lists Radiographer-A at Level 4 for candidates with a first-class radiography diploma and states that the role can progress to Senior Radiographer-B at Level 10 through its merit-promotion scheme, subject to satisfactory performance.

job_role:radiographer.label: Compensation context
job_role:radiographer.text: As dated public-sector reference points, ESIC’s published Radiographer rules list Pay Level 5, ₹29,200–₹92,300 in the pay matrix, while ISRO’s Radiographer-A recruitment norms list Level 4, ₹25,500–₹81,100.

job_role:research-assistant.label: Pay context, not a national salary scale
job_role:research-assistant.text: Published project advertisements illustrate variable consolidated pay: ₹31,000 per month in one ICMR Research Assistant advertisement and ₹37,000 per month in several 2025–26 ICSSR-funded university advertisements.

job_role:research-assistant.label: Compensation context
job_role:research-assistant.text: As dated illustrations, an ICMR Headquarters project advertisement listed ₹31,000 per month consolidated for a Project Assistant (Research Assistant)/Project Technical Support III role, while an IIT Kanpur ICSSR project advertisement dated May 2026 listed ₹37,000 per month consolidated.

job_role:research-assistant.label: Compensation context
job_role:research-assistant.text: A JNU biotechnology project instead listed ₹20,000 plus HRA for a temporary Research Assistant role.

job_role:sales-executive.label: Structured skilling option
job_role:sales-executive.text: For retail-facing sales, NSDC lists the Sales Associate qualification pack, RAS/Q0104, at NSQF Level 4.

job_role:sales-executive.label: Entry routes after BBA or B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
job_role:sales-executive.text: For retail sales, NSDC publishes the Level 4 Sales Associate qualification pack.

job_role:sales-executive.label: Compensation context
job_role:sales-executive.text: As dated examples only, NCS listings visible on July 16–18, 2026 showed Sales Executive advertisements with stated annual salary ranges including ₹1.92–2.40 lakh and ₹2.74–3.36 lakh.

job_role:sales-manager.label: Skills-framework context
job_role:sales-manager.text: Comparable official, sector-specific roles appear at different NSQF levels—for example, Territory Sales Manager (Retail) at Level 5, Territory Sales Manager (Broadband) at Level 7, and an automotive Sales Manager at Level 8.

job_role:sales-manager.label: Pay context, not a benchmark
job_role:sales-manager.text: A National Career Service listing for a Delhi Sales Manager role posted on June 16, 2026 showed ₹312,000–₹360,000 per year.

job_role:sales-manager.label: Compensation context
job_role:sales-manager.text: As a dated example, the National Career Service page showed a Sales Manager vacancy in Delhi with a stated annual salary of ₹312,000–₹360,000, posted June 16, 2026.

job_role:sales-team-leader.label: Official retail qualification reference
job_role:sales-team-leader.text: India’s Retailers Association’s Skill Council of India (RASCI) maps the closely aligned Retail Team Leader role to Qualification Pack RAS/Q0105, Version 3.0, at NSQF Level 4.5 with 16 credits and 480 notional hours.

job_role:sales-team-leader.label: Qualification-entry benchmark
job_role:sales-team-leader.text: Class 12 plus 3 years’ relevant store-operations experience; or a relevant NSQF Level 4 qualification plus 1.5 years’ experience.

job_role:sales-team-leader.label: Apprenticeship route
job_role:sales-team-leader.text: RASCI lists a Retail Team Leader apprenticeship curriculum under the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme and says revised apprenticeship contracts should use “Retail Team Leader Version 3.0,” NSQF Level 4.5.

job_role:sales-team-leader.label: Compensation example, dated
job_role:sales-team-leader.text: An expired National Career Service vacancy for a Sales Team Leader in digital-payment/direct sales, posted on November 6, 2025, advertised ₹20,000–₹40,000 per month and sought 2–5 years of relevant experience.

job_role:sales-team-leader.label: Entry routes in India
job_role:sales-team-leader.text: Class 12 plus 3 years; a relevant NSQF Level 4 qualification plus 1.5 years; or a relevant NSQF Level 3.5 qualification plus 3 years.

job_role:sales-team-leader.label: Progression
job_role:sales-team-leader.text: In RASCI’s current retail occupational map, Retail Sales Executive is listed at NSQF Level 4, Retail Team Leader at Level 4.5, Deputy Manager (Retail Store Department) at Level 5, and Retail Store Manager at Level 5.5.

job_role:sales-team-leader.label: Compensation context
job_role:sales-team-leader.text: As dated context only, a National Career Service listing posted on November 6, 2025 for a Sales Team Leader in digital payments/direct sales advertised ₹20,000–₹40,000 monthly, requested 2–5 years of relevant experience, and identified field sales, B2B sales, team handling and payment QR-code sales among its skills.

job_role:scientist-in-a-government-resea.label: CSIR entry-level designation
job_role:scientist-in-a-government-resea.text: Under CSIR’s CSRAP Rules, 2025 (effective 1 January 2026), Scientist-B is Level 10 in the 7th CPC pay matrix.

job_role:scientist-in-a-government-resea.label: Progression in CSIR
job_role:scientist-in-a-government-resea.text: CSIR’s 2025 framework sets out a Scientist-B to Scientist-G ladder: B (Level 10), C (Level 11), D (Level 12), E (Level 13), F (Level 13A) and G (Level 14).

job_role:scientist-in-a-government-resea.label: Compensation context — dated and variable
job_role:scientist-in-a-government-resea.text: For CSIR, the CSRAP Rules, 2025 place Scientist-B at Pay Level 10 of the 7th CPC matrix, with higher scientist grades progressing through Levels 11, 12, 13, 13A and 14.

job_role:scientist-in-a-government-resea.label: Compensation context — dated and variable
job_role:scientist-in-a-government-resea.text: As a dated official recruitment example, RAC Advertisement 145 described DRDO Scientist-B as Level 10 with a starting matrix figure of ₹56,100 and reported approximate total emoluments of ₹1,00,000 per month at the then-current metro-city rate, inclusive of HRA and other allowances.

job_role:security-manager.label: Closest national skills benchmark
job_role:security-manager.text: India’s NSDC listing identifies the Security Officer qualification (MEP/Q7202) under the occupation “Security Management” at NSQF Level 6.

job_role:security-manager.label: Entry routes in India
job_role:security-manager.text: NSDC’s Security Supervisor qualification (MEP/Q7201) is listed at NSQF Level 5, while its Security Officer qualification (MEP/Q7202), classified in Security Management, is listed at Level 6.

job_role:security-manager.label: Career progression
job_role:security-manager.text: NSDC’s currently listed benchmarks place Security Supervisor at NSQF Level 5 and Security Officer, in the Security Management occupation, at Level 6.

job_role:security-supervisor.label: Recognised occupational standard
job_role:security-supervisor.text: NSDC lists Security Supervisor under Qualification Pack MEP/Q7201 in the private-security sub-sector, classified as supervisory work at NSQF Level 4 (page validated February 13, 2023).

job_role:senior-engineer.label: Salary context
job_role:senior-engineer.text: As a dated market indicator rather than a pay guarantee, Indeed reported an India average base salary of ₹11,69,014 per year for “Senior Engineer,” based on 643 reported salaries and updated on July 2, 2026.

job_role:senior-engineer.label: Compensation context
job_role:senior-engineer.text: As a point-in-time indicator, Indeed listed an India average base salary of ₹11,69,014 per year on July 2, 2026, using 643 reported salaries.

job_role:senior-engineer.label: Compensation context
job_role:senior-engineer.text: For example, Indeed’s Bengaluru page reported ₹13,49,703 per year on July 10, 2026, based on 301 reported salaries.

job_role:senior-fashion-designer.label: Occupational-standard context
job_role:senior-fashion-designer.text: India’s National Skill Development Corporation lists the Apparel Made-Ups & Home Furnishing Sector Skill Council qualification pack AMH/Q1201, “Fashion Designer,” at NSQF Level 5; the listing marks this occupational standard as retired. “Senior Fashion Designer” is therefore best treated as an employer-defined experienced role rather than a separate current national qualification title.

job_role:senior-fashion-designer.label: Entry routes in India
job_role:senior-fashion-designer.text: Separately, NSDC records the Fashion Designer qualification pack AMH/Q1201 at NSQF Level 5, but labels it retired, so applicants should verify whether a training provider’s offered credential is current and recognised.

job_role:senior-fashion-designer.label: Compensation context
job_role:senior-fashion-designer.text: As dated job-market context only, an Indeed listing crawled in July 2026 for a Senior Fashion Designer role in Whitefield, Bengaluru advertised ₹25,000–₹30,000 per month.

job_role:senior-fashion-designer.label: Compensation context
job_role:senior-fashion-designer.text: For comparison, NCS’s older, adjacent Assistant Fashion Designer profile gives an indicative experienced range of ₹20,000–₹27,000 per month and expressly says its figures are subject to change; it should not be extrapolated as senior-designer pay.

job_role:senior-graphic-designer.label: Compensation context
job_role:senior-graphic-designer.text: As dated examples rather than a market-rate estimate, a New Delhi posting dated February 23, 2026 listed ₹10–12 lakh CTC for a 4–10-year senior role, while a remote posting listed ₹6–8 lakh annual CTC; neither should be treated as a standard salary.

job_role:senior-graphic-designer.label: Compensation: how to interpret salary information
job_role:senior-graphic-designer.text: For context only, a Behance listing for an on-site New Delhi senior role posted on February 23, 2026 advertised ₹10–12 lakh CTC for candidates with 4–10 years’ experience.

job_role:senior-graphic-designer.label: Compensation: how to interpret salary information
job_role:senior-graphic-designer.text: A separate remote listing advertised ₹6–8 lakh annual CTC.

job_role:senior-industrial-technician.label: Common foundational training
job_role:senior-industrial-technician.text: DGT’s CTS catalogue includes relevant industrial-maintenance routes such as Mechanic Machine Tool Maintenance (two years, NSQF level 4) and newer manufacturing/automation trades such as Industrial Robotics & Digital Manufacturing Technician and Manufacturing Process Control and Automation Technician.

job_role:senior-industrial-technician.label: Plant-maintenance route
job_role:senior-industrial-technician.text: DGT lists the Flexi-MoU CTS trade “Technician – Plant Maintenance” as a two-year, NSQF level 5 programme with Class 10 Science and Mathematics (or equivalent) entry eligibility.

job_role:senior-industrial-technician.label: Indicative experience benchmark
job_role:senior-industrial-technician.text: For the related NCS profile Maintenance Technician–Mechanical Level 3, NCS states that 2–3 years of maintenance/manufacturing experience is generally required; actual senior-technician requirements vary by employer, plant, trade and safety-critical responsibilities.

job_role:senior-industrial-technician.label: Entry and preparation routes
job_role:senior-industrial-technician.text: DGT lists two-year, NSQF level 4 CTS pathways including Mechanic Machine Tool Maintenance, Fitter, Electrician and Electronics Mechanic, while its catalogue also includes industrial robotics, process-control and IIoT-related technician trades.

job_role:senior-industrial-technician.label: Entry and preparation routes
job_role:senior-industrial-technician.text: A more directly plant-maintenance-oriented option is DGT’s Flexi-MoU CTS “Technician – Plant Maintenance,” listed as a two-year NSQF level 5 course requiring Class 10 Science and Mathematics or equivalent.

job_role:senior-industrial-technician.label: Progression options
job_role:senior-industrial-technician.text: A related NCS maintenance profile gives an indicative pathway from Maintenance Technician–Mechanical Level 3 to Level 4 and then Engineer.

job_role:senior-industrial-technician.label: Compensation context
job_role:senior-industrial-technician.text: As dated reference context only, the NCS page for the related Maintenance Technician–Mechanical Level 3 profile—last updated September 18, 2023—reported ₹12,000–₹18,000 per month for candidates with experience and explicitly labelled the figures indicative and subject to change.

job_role:senior-lab-technician.label: Progression
job_role:senior-lab-technician.text: ISRO’s career information for Lab Technician-A says that an employee can progress up to Senior Lab Technician-B in Pay Level 10 through its Merit Promotion Scheme, subject to satisfactory performance.

job_role:senior-lab-technician.label: Compensation context
job_role:senior-lab-technician.text: As dated examples, an ICMR project advertisement listed a consolidated ₹25,000 per month for a temporary Project Senior Lab Technician post, while ISRO’s career information states that Lab Technician-A can progress to Senior Lab Technician-B at Pay Level 10, with a displayed pay-matrix range of ₹56,100–₹1,77,500.

job_role:senior-operation-theatre-techni.label: Published occupational benchmark
job_role:senior-operation-theatre-techni.text: The Healthcare Sector Skill Council’s published Operating Theatre Technician qualification pack, HSS/Q2601, places the base OTT role at NSQF level 4 and lists Class XII science as the minimum educational qualification; the document describes this as a base-role standard rather than a universal requirement for every employer’s senior designation.

job_role:senior-operation-theatre-techni.label: Example public-sector progression rule
job_role:senior-operation-theatre-techni.text: For Kalawati Saran Children’s Hospital, New Delhi, the 2026 recruitment rules provide for Senior Operation Theatre Technician by promotion from an Operation Theatre Technician in pay level 4 after five years of regular service.

job_role:senior-operation-theatre-techni.label: Government pay context
job_role:senior-operation-theatre-techni.text: In the Kalawati Saran Children’s Hospital recruitment rules published on April 4, 2026, the single Senior Operation Theatre Technician post was Group C, non-gazetted and non-ministerial at pay-matrix Level 5 (₹29,200–₹92,300).

job_role:senior-operation-theatre-techni.label: Entry routes
job_role:senior-operation-theatre-techni.text: At Kalawati Saran Children’s Hospital, the 2026 rule specifies promotion from an OT Technician in Level 4 after five years of regular service, with no direct-recruit qualification prescribed for that post.

job_role:senior-operation-theatre-techni.label: Progression
job_role:senior-operation-theatre-techni.text: The Kalawati Saran Children’s Hospital rules notified in 2026 make the senior post promotional from OT Technician after five years of regular service in Level 4.

job_role:senior-operation-theatre-techni.label: Compensation context
job_role:senior-operation-theatre-techni.text: As a dated public-sector reference, the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare’s recruitment rules published on April 4, 2026 classified one Senior Operation Theatre Technician post at Kalawati Saran Children’s Hospital, New Delhi as Level 5 in the central pay matrix, ₹29,200–₹92,300; the post count was stated as one, subject to variation with workload.

job_role:senior-physiotherapist.label: Role positioning
job_role:senior-physiotherapist.text: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW) physiotherapy handbook’s proposed clinical pathway places Physiotherapist at NSQF Level 6 and Senior Physiotherapist at Level 7, while individual employers may use different grades and promotion rules.

job_role:senior-physiotherapist.label: Government pay context
job_role:senior-physiotherapist.text: As a dated employer-specific example, Safdarjung Hospital’s 2025 rules attach Senior Physiotherapist to Central Pay Matrix Level 10, with a basic-pay range of ₹56,100–₹1,77,500.

job_role:senior-physiotherapist.label: Entry route into the senior role
job_role:senior-physiotherapist.text: For example, Safdarjung Hospital’s 2025 Senior Physiotherapist rules provide promotion from Level 6 Physiotherapist after 10 years of regular service plus prescribed two-to-four-week training; a transitional note retains eight years’ eligibility for people already holding the feeder post on the notification date.

job_role:senior-physiotherapist.label: Compensation context
job_role:senior-physiotherapist.text: For a dated central-government reference point, Safdarjung Hospital’s Senior Physiotherapist Recruitment Rules, 2025 place the post at Pay Matrix Level 10 with basic pay of ₹56,100–₹1,77,500.

job_role:senior-radiographer.label: Public-pay context
job_role:senior-radiographer.text: As dated examples, CRPF rules published for a 2022 cadre designation placed Senior Radiographer at Pay Matrix Level 6 (₹35,400–₹1,12,400), while ISRO’s published career-prospects page lists Senior Radiographer-B at Level 10 (₹56,100–₹1,77,500).

job_role:senior-radiographer.label: Compensation context
job_role:senior-radiographer.text: For context, CRPF recruitment rules for its cadre designation state that personnel designated Senior Radiographer draw Pay Matrix Level 6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400.

job_role:senior-radiographer.label: Compensation context
job_role:senior-radiographer.text: ISRO’s career-prospects page lists Senior Radiographer-B at Level 10, ₹56,100–₹1,77,500, via merit promotion.

job_role:senior-sales-executive.label: Formal skilling reference
job_role:senior-sales-executive.text: For retail-facing sales, RASCI lists the active Retail Sales Executive qualification (RAS/Q0109), NSQF Level 4, version 2, with a stated 480-hour duration and expiry date of 27 August 2027.

job_role:senior-sales-executive.label: Routes from Sales Executive to a senior role
job_role:senior-sales-executive.text: A bachelor’s degree is commonly requested or preferred for professional B2B and enterprise sales roles, but a formal degree is not the only route: retail-sector skilling provides an active Retail Sales Executive qualification at NSQF Level 4.

job_role:senior-sales-executive.label: Likely progression
job_role:senior-sales-executive.text: In retail’s current RASCI framework, Retail Sales Executive is placed at NSQF Level 4 and Retail Team Leader at Level 4.5, illustrating a possible move from individual selling toward team-level responsibility.

job_role:senior-software-engineer.label: Indian occupational reference
job_role:senior-software-engineer.text: The National Skill Development Corporation’s National Occupational Standards catalogue lists “Software Engineer_v2.0” under the IT-ITeS Sector Skill Council, in Software Development, at NSQF level 7 (SSC/Q4601). “Senior Software Engineer” is a senior employer title within this broader occupation rather than a separate national occupational standard in that catalogue.

job_role:senior-software-engineer.label: Compensation caution
job_role:senior-software-engineer.text: The NCS page, last updated August 9, 2016, shows an indicative monthly range of ₹46,000–₹65,000 for experienced Software Engineers and says its figures are subject to change.

job_role:senior-software-engineer.label: Compensation context
job_role:senior-software-engineer.text: For historical context only, the NCS software-engineer profile was last updated on August 9, 2016 and reported ₹46,000–₹65,000 per month for experienced Software Engineers, explicitly calling those figures indicative and subject to change.

job_role:seo-content-writer.label: Compensation context
job_role:seo-content-writer.text: As a dated, non-official market snapshot, Jooble reported an India SEO Content Writer average of ₹3,54,505 per year as of 20 May 2026; this is an aggregator estimate, not a guaranteed offer or statutory wage.

job_role:seo-content-writer.label: Compensation: use market figures cautiously
job_role:seo-content-writer.text: As a dated market indicator only, Jooble listed an India average of ₹3,54,505 per year for an SEO Content Writer on 20 May 2026.

job_role:seo-manager.label: India compensation context
job_role:seo-manager.text: The salary aggregator AmbitionBox reported an India SEO Manager range of ₹3 lakh–₹18 lakh annually, based on 3,600 reported salaries and updated 30 July 2025.

job_role:seo-manager.label: India compensation context
job_role:seo-manager.text: This is historical, self-reported market context—not a 2026 salary promise; pay varies materially by experience, city, industry, employer and scope.

job_role:seo-manager.label: Compensation context
job_role:seo-manager.text: As a dated reference point rather than a current benchmark, AmbitionBox’s India page reported an annual SEO Manager salary range of ₹3 lakh to ₹18 lakh from 3,600 reported salaries, last updated on 30 July 2025.

job_role:service-manager.label: Occupation code
job_role:service-manager.text: India’s National Classification of Occupations (NCO) 2015 identifies Area Service Manager as code 1213.0201, associated with Qualification Pack ASC/Q0603 and NSQF Level 6.

job_role:service-operations-manager.label: Indian occupational reference point
job_role:service-operations-manager.text: The closest explicitly listed National Career Service (NCS) reference is “Area Service Manager” (alias: Service Manager), classified as NCO 2015 code 1213.0201 and aligned to ASC/Q0603 at NSQF Level 6.

job_role:service-operations-manager.label: Indicative pay context, not a current salary quote
job_role:service-operations-manager.text: NCS’s Area Service Manager profile, last updated September 18, 2023, reported indicative monthly earnings of ₹15,000–₹25,000 for new entrants and ₹25,000–₹60,000 for experienced candidates.

job_role:service-operations-manager.label: Compensation context
job_role:service-operations-manager.text: As a dated public reference only, NCS’s automotive Area Service Manager profile was last updated on September 18, 2023 and listed indicative earnings of ₹15,000–₹25,000 per month for new entrants and ₹25,000–₹60,000 per month for experienced candidates.

job_role:service-operations-manager.label: Compensation context
job_role:service-operations-manager.text: NCS explicitly labels these figures indicative and subject to change, so they should be used only as historical context—not as a July 2026 salary expectation or a benchmark for all sectors.

job_role:set-designer.label: Recognised occupational standard
job_role:set-designer.text: India’s Media & Entertainment Skill Council (MESC) lists “Art Director (Set Designing)” as qualification pack MES/Q3102, version 3.0, at NSQF Level 6; the accompanying model curriculum states that this role may also be referred to as a Set Designer.

job_role:skill-assessor-for-vocational-q.label: Entry routes and assessor preparation
job_role:skill-assessor-for-vocational-q.text: Assessing Levels 6.5 through 8 normally requires NSQF Level 8 with five years of relevant experience, or a relevant certified Master Assessor.

job_role:skill-assessor-for-vocational-q.label: Progression options
job_role:skill-assessor-for-vocational-q.text: The stated Master Assessor benchmark is a minimum NCrF/NSQF Level 5.5 (graduate and above) and 10 years of relevant industry, academic or assessor experience.

job_role:software-developer.label: Skill standard
job_role:software-developer.text: NSDC’s National Occupational Standards catalogue lists the IT-ITeS Sector Skill Council qualification pack SSC/Q6702, “Software Developer,” under Application Development at NSQF level 7.

job_role:staff-nurse.label: Compensation context
job_role:staff-nurse.text: As dated public-sector reference points only, the Railway Recruitment Board’s CEN 03/2025 listed Nursing Superintendent at Pay Level 7 with initial pay of ₹44,900, while AIIMS NORCET-10 described Nursing Officer posts at Pay Level 7 and noted that usual Central Government allowances apply according to the employing institute and city.

job_role:systems-analyst.label: Historic pay context
job_role:systems-analyst.text: A NIELIT advertisement numbered 07/223/2020 stated a consolidated monthly range of ₹26,625–₹33,600 for its Systems Analyst engagement.

job_role:systems-analyst.label: Compensation context
job_role:systems-analyst.text: The available official figure should be treated only as dated context: NIELIT’s advertisement numbered 07/223/2020 listed a consolidated ₹26,625–₹33,600 per month for one Systems Analyst engagement that required at least three years of specified IT experience.

job_role:systems-analyst.label: Compensation context
job_role:systems-analyst.text: It is not a 2026 salary estimate and should not be extrapolated to private-sector, permanent-government or other analyst roles.

job_role:technical-lead.label: Relevant Indian occupational standard
job_role:technical-lead.text: Technical Lead is not presented as a separate National Occupational Classification in the cited source; the National Skill Development Corporation lists the IT-ITeS Sector Skill Council Software Engineer qualification pack SSC/Q4601 at NSQF level 7, which is relevant to the underlying software-engineering pathway.

job_role:technician-in-public-sector-und.label: Illustrative pay context
job_role:technician-in-public-sector-und.text: In the cited NTPC Artisan Trainee notice, the training stipend and the starting basic pay after successful training were each ₹21,500 per month; this is a dated example, not a current sector-wide salary benchmark.

job_role:technician-in-public-sector-und.label: Compensation context
job_role:technician-in-public-sector-und.text: As a concrete dated example, NTPC’s cited Artisan Trainee notice provided a consolidated training stipend of ₹21,500 per month for two years and stated that, after successful training, placement would be in W3 with a starting basic pay of ₹21,500.

job_role:ticketing-and-reservations-exec.label: Relevant national skill benchmarks
job_role:ticketing-and-reservations-exec.text: Comparable Indian skill qualifications include Airline Reservation Agent (AAS/Q0302), listed at NSQF Level 4, and Ticketing Consultant (THC/Q4302), listed at NSQF Level 5.

job_role:ticketing-and-reservations-exec.label: Entry routes after BTTM
job_role:ticketing-and-reservations-exec.text: A skills-first route can also be relevant, particularly for airline-reservation work: AASSC lists Airline Reservation Agent as a 540-hour Level 4 course, while NSDC lists the associated AAS/Q0302 qualification at Level 4.

job_role:ticketing-and-reservations-exec.label: Possible progression
job_role:ticketing-and-reservations-exec.text: NSDC's tourism-and-hospitality listings show a useful skills-framework ladder around the role: Reservation Desk Executive is listed at Level 4 in the retired standards catalogue, while Ticketing Consultant is listed at Level 5 and Team Leader–Travel at Level 5 (with a separate Team Leader listing at Level 6).

job_role:tour-operations-executive.label: Industry alignment
job_role:tour-operations-executive.text: The closest National Skills framework reference is the Tourism & Hospitality Skill Council’s Travel Consultant qualification (THC/Q4404), in the Tours and Travels sub-sector and Tour Packaging occupation at NSQF Level 4.

job_role:tour-operations-executive.label: Entry routes after BTTM
job_role:tour-operations-executive.text: NSDC lists the Travel Consultant qualification under Tour Packaging at NSQF Level 4, with 270 total training hours shown on its course page; it is a useful adjacent benchmark, not a requirement for every employer.

job_role:tour-operations-executive.label: Progression outlook
job_role:tour-operations-executive.text: It is set at NSQF Level 5.5 and its stated entry pathways require substantial prior education-and-experience combinations, so it is better understood as a later-career benchmark than an entry-level credential.

job_role:travel-consultant.label: National skills standard
job_role:travel-consultant.text: The Tourism & Hospitality Skill Council qualification pack identifies the role as Travel Consultant, QP code THC/Q4404, in the Tours and Travels sub-sector and Tour Packaging occupation at NSQF Level 4.5.

job_role:travel-consultant.label: Entry routes after BTTM
job_role:travel-consultant.text: THSC’s Travel Consultant qualification pack (THC/Q4404) defines an NSQF Level 4.5 role and is accompanied by a model curriculum.

job_role:travel-consultant.label: Compensation context
job_role:travel-consultant.text: As a dated reference only, the National Career Service page for the related Travel Agent occupation—last updated December 29, 2023—listed ₹14,500 to ₹32,000 per month for candidates with experience and expressly described the figures as indicative and subject to change.

job_role:urban-planner.label: Compensation context
job_role:urban-planner.text: As a dated public-sector example—not a national salary benchmark—Ladakh’s Assistant Town Planner Recruitment Rules, 2024 list Pay Level 8A, with a pay-matrix range of ₹50,700–₹160,600.

job_role:visual-merchandiser.label: Sector and qualification level
job_role:visual-merchandiser.text: India’s National Qualifications Register lists Visual Merchandiser as a Retail-sector certificate qualification at NCrF/NSQF level 4.5 (NQR code QG-4.5-OR-02430-2024-V2-RASCI).

job_role:wealth-manager.label: Regulated-advisory certification
job_role:wealth-manager.text: For an individual SEBI-registered investment adviser, or the principal officer of a non-individual registered investment adviser, NISM states that both NISM-Series-X-A (Investment Adviser Level 1) and NISM-Series-X-B (Investment Adviser Level 2) are required to meet the certification requirements under the SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013.

job_role:wealth-manager.label: Entry routes from BFIA and the CFA Program
job_role:wealth-manager.text: NISM states that individual registered investment advisers, principal officers of non-individual registered advisers, and associated persons providing investment advice must meet the applicable Investment Adviser Level 1 and Level 2 certification requirements.

job_role:wealth-manager.label: Core skills to develop
job_role:wealth-manager.text: NISM’s Level 1 objectives include evaluating a client’s financial position, debt and loans, financial products across equity, debt, derivatives and managed portfolios, portfolio construction, performance monitoring, regulation, ethics, and grievance redressal.

job_role:web-developer.label: Indicative pay context
job_role:web-developer.text: The NCS Web Developer profile, last updated on 9 August 2016, reported indicative monthly earnings of ₹8,000–₹12,500 for new entrants and ₹20,000–₹45,000 for experienced candidates.

job_role:web-developer.label: Compensation context
job_role:web-developer.text: For dated historical context only, the National Career Service Web Developer profile—last updated on 9 August 2016—listed indicative earnings of ₹8,000–₹12,500 per month for new entrants and ₹20,000–₹45,000 per month for candidates with experience, while explicitly stating that the figures were indicative and subject to change.

job_role:web-developer.label: Compensation context
job_role:web-developer.text: These figures should not be used to set a 2026 salary expectation; candidates should compare current, location-specific offers and the complete compensation terms.
